title: HR Specialist, Payroll and Benefits
description:
**Guidant Measurement**
*(legal entity Exactura Measurement India Pvt. Ltd. )*

Delivers high-accuracy measurement solutions for the global energy industry. Built on the legacy of trusted brands Smith Meter®, INVALCO®, and Sening®, our technologies support custody transfer, terminal automation, and fluid measurement across production, transportation, and storage operations.

From flow meters and electronic measurement platforms to integrated terminal systems, Guidant solutions help customers operate safely, efficiently, and with confidence in the accuracy of every transaction.

With a global network of engineering, manufacturing, and service expertise, Guidant partners with operators around the world to solve complex measurement challenges and support the evolving energy landscape.

**Key Responsibilities We Will Trust You With:**

**The Human Resources Specialist, Payroll & Benefits position**
is responsible for supporting all day-to-day HR operations for approximately 30+ employees within the company's India Center of Excellence (COE). This position serves as the primary local HR resource, managing payroll administration, employee benefits, HR compliance, employee support, onboarding, and recruitment coordination.

The India COE primarily consists of Finance & Accounting professionals and Tender/Proposal Engineering employees who support a multinational organization. The successful candidate will work independently with limited supervision while partnering closely with global HR, finance, payroll providers, benefits vendors, and business leaders to ensure an exceptional employee experience and compliance with local employment regulations.

**Payroll Administration**

* Administer and coordinate monthly payroll processing for India employees through external payroll providers.
* Review payroll inputs including new hires, employee changes, leave records, incentive payments, and statutory deductions.
* Validate payroll reports for accuracy and reconcile discrepancies before payroll submission.
* Partner with payroll vendors and finance teams to ensure timely and accurate payroll processing.
* Support payroll audits, reporting requirements, and employee payroll inquiries.
* Maintain employee payroll records and documentation in accordance with company policies and regulatory requirements.

**Benefits Administration**

* Serve as the primary point of contact for employee benefits programs.
* Coordinate with insurance carriers, benefits brokers, and third-party vendors regarding enrollment, renewals, employee changes, and claims support.
* Administer employee benefits including medical insurance, life insurance, retirement programs, and wellness initiatives.
* Support annual benefits reviews and renewal activities.
* Educate employees on available benefit programs and resolve routine benefits-related questions.
* Monitor benefits utilization and provide data and recommendations to HR leadership.

**Human Resources Operations**

* Maintain accurate employee records and HR information systems.
* Support onboarding and offboarding activities, including documentation, orientation, system access coordination, and exit processes.
* Prepare employment letters, HR documents, and required employee communications.
* Support performance management, engagement initiatives, and employee relations activities.
* Ensure compliance with Indian labor laws, statutory requirements, and company policies.
* Assist with HR reporting, audits, and workforce data analysis.

**Talent Acquisition Support**

* Support front-end recruitment activities for India-based positions.
* Partner with hiring managers to schedule interviews and coordinate candidate communications.
* Manage job postings through recruitment platforms and company systems.
* Screen resumes and conduct initial candidate assessments for selected positions.
* Coordinate offer documentation and pre-employment activities.
* Support onboarding activities for new hires to ensure a seamless employee experience.

**Employee Support**

* Respond to employee inquiries related to payroll, benefits, HR policies, and employment matters.
* Build positive relationships with employees and managers across the India COE.
* Promote a professional, customer-service-oriented HR experience.
* Escalate complex employee issues appropriately while maintaining confidentiality.

**Other**

* Support the global HR team in general HR projects, initiatives and general employee support.
* Provide general HR support to Middle East managers and employees as needed.

**Your Areas of Knowledge and Expertise that matter most for this role:**

**Education**

* Bachelor's degree in Human Resources, Business Administration, Commerce, or a related field.
* HR certifications are considered an advantage.

**Experience**

* 5 plus years of progressive Human Resources experience.
* Demonstrated experience administering payroll in India.
* Experience working with third-party payroll providers; ADP experience preferred but not required.
* Experience managing employee benefits programs and working with benefits brokers, insurance providers, and external vendors.
* Experience supporting HR operations in a multinational or matrixed organization preferred.
* Basic recruiting and talent acquisition coordination experience required.

**Knowledge & Skills**

* Strong understanding of India payroll practices, statutory compliance, PF, ESIC, gratuity, and applicable labor regulations.
* Knowledge of HR processes including onboarding, employee records management, benefits administration, and employee relations.
* Strong organizational skills with exceptional attention to detail and accuracy.
* Ability to manage sensitive and confidential information with discretion.
* Excellent verbal and written communication skills in English.
* Strong Microsoft Office skills, particularly Excel.
* Experience with HRIS and payroll systems.
* Ability to work independently, prioritize multiple responsibilities, and meet deadlines in a fast-paced environment.
* Strong problem-solving and customer service orientation.

**Preferred Qualifications**

* Experience with ADP payroll systems.
* Experience supporting a Center of Excellence or shared services environment.
* Exposure to global HR practices and collaboration with regional or corporate HR teams.
* Experience supporting professional services, finance, accounting, engineering, or technical employee populations.

**Success Factors -**
The successful candidate will be:

* Self-directed and capable of managing daily HR operations with limited supervision.
* Detail-oriented and highly accurate in payroll and benefits administration.
* Responsive and service-focused when supporting employees and managers.
* Comfortable working with local and global stakeholders across functions.
* Able to balance operational excellence, compliance requirements, and employee experience.

**Key Interactions**

**Key Internal Interactions**

* India Employees for payroll, benefits, onboarding, HR policy guidance, and employee support.
* India Managers and Team Leaders regarding recruitment, onboarding, performance support, employee relations matters, attendance, support in organizational changes.
* Regional and Global Human Resources Teams to ensure alignment with global HR policies, programs, processes, and reporting requirements.
* Finance and Accounting Teams for payroll validation, employee compensation changes, accruals, reconciliations, and statutory compliance.
* Global Talent Acquisition Team to coordinate recruitment activities, candidate movement, and hiring processes.
* IT and Operations Teams to support onboarding, offboarding, and employee system access requirements.
* Business Leaders and Functional Management to support workforce planning, employee engagement, compliance, and local HR initiatives.

**Key External Interactions**

* Payroll Service Providers to coordinate accurate and timely payroll processing.
* Benefits Brokers and Insurance Providers for medical, life insurance, and employee benefit program administration.
* Statutory and Government Agencies related to Provident Fund (PF), Employee State Insurance (ESI), gratuity, labor compliance, and other regulatory requirements.
* Recruitment Agencies and Job Board Providers to support sourcing and hiring activities for India-based positions.
* Background Verification Vendors for pre-employment screening and onboarding support.
* External Auditors and Compliance Partners as needed for payroll, benefits, and employment compliance reviews.

**Work Environment:**

A positive and collaborative office environment where open communication is encouraged, fostering a supportive team atmosphere with opportunities for professional development.

General physical conditions include working in a temperature-controlled office environment with good air quality, adequate lighting and low level of noise.

**Physical Demands**

Combination office environment and travel required. Frequent sitting. Daily personal computer usage, frequent use of mobile phone. Some air travel may be required which is generally domestic travel.

**1\. Recruitment \& Talent Acquisition**

**LinkedIn, Naukri, Indeed and other relevant job portals/platforms**

* Ensure HR processes and documentation are followed consistently.

* Support employee communication and HR announcements.
* Conduct regular employee connect activities and address routine employee queries.

**5\. Performance Management**

* Track probation reviews, performance discussions and appraisal timelines.
* Maintain performance\-related documentation.
* Follow up with managers and employees to ensure reviews are completed on time.



  





**6\. HR Compliance \& Documentation** 



* Support statutory and HR compliance activities.
* Maintain accurate employee records and required documentation.
* Coordinate with external consultants/vendors wherever required for payroll, compliance or HR\-related matters.
* Ensure confidentiality of employee and company information.



  





**7\. HR MIS \& Reporting** 



* Prepare regular HR reports and dashboards.
* Maintain recruitment, attrition, attendance, leave and employee data.
* Track HR metrics and highlight pending actions to management.
* Maintain accurate and organised HR documentation.



  





**Required Skills \& Experience** 



* Experience: 4–5 years in HR, with strong hands\-on experience in recruitment and HR operations. Candidates with 4–5 years of relevant experience will be preferred
 
**.**
* Graduate/Postgraduate degree in Human Resources, Business Administration or a related field.
* Good understanding of recruitment and HR operations.
* Hands\-on experience with employee lifecycle management.
* Good understanding of attendance, leave, payroll coordination and HR documentation.
* Exposure to HRMS systems is preferred.
* Good knowledge of MS Excel/Google Sheets and HR MIS.
* Strong verbal and written communication skills.
* Strong coordination and follow\-up skills.
* Ability to maintain confidentiality and handle sensitive employee information.
* Ability to work independently and take ownership of assigned responsibilities.

**Kolshet, Thane office five days a week** 

 .



  





**Preferred Candidate Profile** 





 We are looking for someone who is:
 



* Hands\-on and execution\-oriented.
* Comfortable working in a growing organisation.
* Strong in communication and interpersonal skills.
* Organised and detail\-oriented.
* Proactive in following up and closing HR tasks.
* Able to work with employees and managers across different levels.
* Capable of handling multiple HR activities simultaneously.
* Comfortable taking ownership rather than waiting for instructions.



  





**Key Performance Areas** 



* Recruitment closures and turnaround time

* Timely completion of onboarding and exit formalities
* Payroll and attendance input accuracy
* Employee query resolution and response time
* HR MIS accuracy and timely reporting
* Completion of probation and performance review processes
* Employee engagement initiatives

**What Technosprout Offers**

title: P&C Senior Partner, Castrol
description:
**Entity**
 People, Culture \& Communications

 HR Group
   

  

**Job Description**
**This is a role within the Castrol organisation, and the successful candidate will become part of the Castrol ring\-fence. If you are part of the ring\-fence, it is expected that your employment will move with Castrol to new ownership.**
 Are you ready to join a team that’s driving the future of lubricants \& beyond and setting new industry standards? Discover how our diverse and passionate people at Castrol are shaping the industry – and how you can be part of this journey.
   

  

 We’re seeking versatile experts who share our passion for innovation and excellence. Bring your outstanding perspective, collaborative spirit, and challenge our thinking as we continue to lead the way in the lubricants' market \& build businesses beyond lubricants. This is your chance to learn, grow, and thrive in a dynamic and inclusive organization.
   

  

**Apply now!**
 We are currently looking for
 **P\&C Senior Partner, Castrol** 
 based at
 **Mumbai** 
 with details mentioned below.
   

  

**Let me tell you about the role!**
 Responsible for supporting employees and line managers within Castrol India limited in the designated teams. The role is to partner with line managers to deliver the full people plan in support of the business delivery. Whilst experience of the full employee lifecycle is required, for this role particular focus lies in the areas of capability talent management, employee engagement, DE\&I and coaching/developing and working with the other centre of expertise in the P\&C wider team.
   

  

 The role holder may operate as a member of a business leadership team, providing business driven insights to support decision making and resolve appropriate global / business wide interventions. They may also act as coach to that team, and a champion for team effectiveness and ‘who we are’. They will also support and work in partnership with other senior business partners in the delivery of P\&C initiatives for the business.
   

  

**About Castrol India Limited**
 Castrol is a leading lubricant brand globally. In India, Castrol is a publicly listed company and operates in the Automotive, Industrial and Marine lubricant sectors. With strong brands, continuous innovation, enduring stakeholder relationships and highly energized employees, we have maintained our market leadership position in India for more than 100 years. Our manufacturing and distribution network in India includes three blending plants and 330 distributors who reach consumers and customers through 100,000\+ retail outlets.
   

  

 Success has no limits at Castrol, and we offer our employees a fast\-paced learning environment and an opportunity to develop careers around functional specialization or on a general management track. Castrol India has consistently groomed top talent to take on leadership roles within the bp group, be it in India or globally.
   

  

 Castrol, one of the world’s leading lubricant brands, has a proud heritage of innovation and fuelling the dreams of pioneers. Its passion for performance, combined with a philosophy of working in partnership, has enabled Castrol to develop lubricants and greases that have been at the heart of numerous technological feats on land, air, sea, and space for over 100 years.
   

  

 Today, Castrol is helping drive sustainability with our new strategy that sets out aims for 2030 to save waste, reduce carbon and improve lives. It is also developing and testing new products and business models to adapt to developments in mobility and digitisation, in addition to sustainability.
   

  

 Castrol aims to grow its business through expansion in growth markets, extending Castrol’s branded service and maintenance offers globally, and providing market leading offers in EV fluids.
   

  

**What will you deliver?**
**Key Accountabilities**
 Develop a deep understanding of the business they support and focuses on driving and delivering organisational change initiatives as appropriate.
   

  

 Partners closely with business partners across enablers, businesses and geographies to agree and define product outcomes/what success looks like for deliverables.
   

  

 Delivers people \& culture advisory support to leaders and may facilitate resolution of everyday queries and coaching to drive engagement, pre\-empting and resolving employee relations (ER) cases and ensuring that diversity and inclusion are a foundation of the business’ people plan and supported throughout all people management activity.
   

  

 Partners to drive talent management initiatives, enabling people to build the capabilities our business needs for growth and ensuring implementation of focused talent management processes that are aligned to business priorities and objectives, auditing their impact on organisational effectiveness.
   

  

 Enables a compliant and high\-performance culture through aligned performance management, reward and recognition frameworks, leading the delivery of integrated reward/recognition solutions to the business and coordinating the annual reward process.
   

  

 Drives the appropriate behaviours to achieve success, including a continuous improvement culture, whilst shares information, provides coaching to other team members in partnership with appropriate product owner/activity manager.
   

  

 Leads and supports the roll out and embedding of key people process and related.
   

  

**Key Capabilities**
**What will make you successful**
* Partnering with the business \& coaching for success
* Proactive talent management \& Employee relations
* Willingness to challenge established practices and offer new solutions if needed
* Fantastic communication skills and the ability to influence key senior stake\-holders
* Strong stakeholder management skills, offering solutions to meet organisational needs
* Strong capability in building influential relationships internally (with P\&C business partners, other functional leaders, business leaders and board members) and externally
* Excellent communication skills, including verbal, written, formal and informal communication with executive presence
* Progressive thinking attitude


 Our values
   

  

* always putting our people first, understanding and responding to their needs, supporting their health, wellbeing and recognizing them for excellent work
* hiring and developing versatile people and empowering them to progress
* enabling an inclusive and agile culture, where our teams thrive and make valuable contributions
* creating energizing workplaces that enable collaboration and innovation.


**Essential Education**
 Master’s degree or equivalent in Human Resources.
   

  

**Essential Experience And Job Requirements**
 Long term experience in Human Resources, validated capability and experience in strategic talent management, ER, change management, and organisational development. Track record of effective strategic partnering and executive level coaching, with confirmed ability to apply business insight and clearly link value to business results. Experience with organisational change and working in a matrixed organization and solid understanding of local labour legislation and regulations.
   

  

 Desirable criteria
   

  

 Experience working with agile methodologies (scrum, kanban, design thinking, etc.)
   

  

**Why join our team?**
 We support our people to learn and grow in a diverse and exciting environment. We believe that our team is strengthened by diversity. We are committed to crafting an inclusive environment in which everyone is respected and treated fairly.
   

  

 We will ensure that individuals with disabilities are provided reasonable accommodation to participate in the job application or interview process, to perform crucial job functions, and to receive other benefits and privileges of employment.
   

  

**Travel Requirement**
 No travel is expected with this role
   

  

**Relocation Assistance:**
 This role is eligible for relocation within country
   

  

**Remote Type**
 This position is not available for remote working
   

  

**Skills**
 Agility core practices, Agility core practices, Analytical Thinking, Coaching, Communication, Creativity and Innovation, Culture and behaviour change, Curiosity, Customer centric thinking, Data Analysis, Data cleansing and transformation, Decision Making, Digital Fluency, Employee and labour relations (Inactive), Employee Engagement, Employee Experience, Facilitation, Global Perspective, Influencing, Job Design, Leadership Assessment, Leading transformation, Managing change, Managing workforce concerns, Microsoft Excel {\+ 12 more}

 We are an equal opportunity employer. We do not discriminate on the basis of protected characteristics like race, religion, color, sex, national origin, sexual orientation, veteran status or disability status. Individuals with an accessibility need may request an adjustment/accommodation related to bp’s recruiting process (e.g., accessing the job application, completing required assessments, participating in telephone screenings or interviews, etc.). If you would like to request an adjustment/accommodation related to the recruitment process, please contact us.
   

  

 If you are selected for a position and depending upon your role, your employment may be contingent upon adherence to local policy. This may include pre\-placement drug screening, medical review of physical fitness for the role, and background checks.

title: Human Resources Payroll
company: Smart Moves Talent Crafters Pvt. Ltd.
description:
Designation : HR Executive \- Logistics and Payroll
 



 Industry : Logistics/ Warehousing/ Transportation
 



 Report to : HR Manager
 



 Location : 2 days Nerul seawood estate and 4 days Uran at their CFS. (Only Mumbai candidates shall apply who are willing to travel)
 



  





 Job Purpose
 



 Responsible for end\-to\-end HR operations for logistics and warehouse employees, including driver and staff payroll, attendance, recruitment, employee relations, IR matters, training, recognition and rewards, and statutory compliance.
 



  





 Key Responsibilities
 



 • Process and verify monthly payroll for drivers, warehouse associates and office staff.
 



 • Verify attendance, leave, overtime, incentives, advances, LOP, duty records and trip sheets.
 



 • Handle recruitment, candidate screening, interviews, salary discussions and joining formalities.
 



 • Maintain employee master data, HRMS records, personnel files and onboarding documentation.
 



 • Handle employee grievances, IR issues, disciplinary matters and workplace conflicts.
 



 • Coordinate with Operations on absenteeism, misconduct, employee disputes and disciplinary actions.
 



 • Support warning letters, show\-cause notices, domestic enquiry and employee\-relations documentation.
 



 • Plan and coordinate driver training on safety, discipline, attendance, company policies and operational procedures.
 



 • Maintain driver training records, attendance, feedback and periodic refresher\-training schedules. • Coordinate Drivers/Associates Recognition \& Rewards (R\&R), including monthly/quarterly recognition, appreciation and incentive programs.
 



 • Ensure compliance with Minimum Wages, PF, ESIC, PT, Bonus, Gratuity and applicable labour laws.
 



 • Maintain statutory registers and documents for labour inspections, audits and compliance reviews.
 



 • Coordinate with manpower vendors regarding payroll, statutory compliance and employee\-related issues.
 



 • Prepare HR MIS covering manpower, attendance, payroll, recruitment, attrition, IR, training, R\&R and compliance.
 



 Required Skills \& Qualifications
 



 • Graduate in HR / Business Administration or relevant discipline.
 



 • 2–5 years of experience in HR Operations, Payroll, Logistics HR or Industrial Relations.
 



 • Good knowledge of MS Excel, HRMS, payroll processing and attendance management.
 



 • Working knowledge of PF, ESIC, Minimum Wages, PT, Bonus, Gratuity and labour compliance.
 



 • Strong employee\-handling, communication, training coordination, problem\-solving and follow\-up skills.
 



  





 Interested candidates can share resumes on zainab.malekpurwala@smartmoves.co.in

title: Manager - Industry Interface & Career Advancement
description:
**BITS Law School, BITS Pilani \| Mumbai Campus, Kalyan, Maharashtra** 




  





**Profile Summary** 




 The Manager is responsible for operationalizing the internship programme at BITS Law School, Mumbai. The role drives end\-to\-end ownership of industry engagement, student career development, and programme performance.
 



 The incumbent will serve as the primary liaison between the school and the legal industry, ensuring that students gain high\-quality, practice\-ready experience while building a robust recruiter network aligned with the school’s reputation for academic excellence.
 



  





**Job Specification** 



* **Position Title:** 
 Manager \- Industry Interface \& Career Advancement
* **Reporting To:** 
 Head, Industry Interface \& Career Advancement
* **Area of Specialization:** 
 Legal Careers, Career Advancement, Industry Relations \& Career Counselling



  





**Key Responsibilities** 




 1\. Strategy \& Program Development
 


* Execute and implement the annual internship strategy aligned with the school’s academic and placement goals
* Identify and establish internship goals, targets, and timelines each academic year
* Formulate workflows and SOPs for end\-to\-end internship processes
* Devise key performance metrics to monitor program effectiveness and report outcomes to senior leadership



 2\. Recruiter Outreach \& Engagement
 


* Identify, build, and maintain relationships with international organizations, law firms, corporate legal teams, judiciary bodies, NGOs, and policy organizations as internship hosts
* Conduct outreach campaigns to onboard new recruiters and retain existing partners
* Negotiate internship agreements, stipend structures, and role definitions with employer partners
* Facilitate recruiter presentations, campus visits, and information sessions for students



 3\. Student Outreach \& Counselling
 


* Counsel students on internship opportunities, career pathways, application strategies, and professional conduct expectations
* Guide students through the internship application lifecycle, including document preparation, interview readiness, and onboarding
* Address and resolve student concerns related to internship placements, workplace issues, and post\-internship evaluations
* Maintain updated records of student internship history, feedback, and performance outcomes



 4\. Student Training \& Skill Development
 


* Execute and deliver pre\-internship training modules covering professional skills, legal drafting, research techniques, and workplace etiquette
* Collaborate with faculty and industry professionals to conduct workshops, mock interviews, and networking events
* Evaluate training effectiveness and update curriculum based on industry feedback and student outcomes



 5\. Performance Metrics \& Reporting
 


* Define, track, and report KPIs such as internship conversion rates, recruiter satisfaction scores, and student placement statistics
* Prepare periodic reports and presentations for the office on program performance
* Benchmark internship outcomes against peer law schools and recommend program improvements.



  





**Qualification** 



* **Essential:** 
 LL.B. (Graduate in Law) from a recognized university
* **Preferred:** 
 Master’s Degree (Preferably in Law)



  





**Experience** 



* **8–10 years** 
 in career counselling, legal recruitment, law school placement, or related field.



  





**Prerequisite Knowledge** 



* Understanding of the legal industry landscape – international organizations, law firms, in\-house counsel, judiciary, and public interest law
* Familiarity with careers, internship \& placement operations in educational institutions
* Proficiency in MS Office (Excel, Word, PowerPoint)
* Experience with placement management tools preferred



  





**Key Skills \& Competencies** 



* Strategic planning and program management
* Stakeholder management – students, faculty, and external recruiters
* Strong communication, negotiation, and relationship\-building skills
* Data\-driven mindset: ability to define, track, and interpret KPIs
* Student counselling and mentoring ability
* Training design and facilitation
* Willingness to travel for recruiter outreach, industry events, and inter\-campus coordination.

title: Human Resources Business Advisor, Vice President
description:
**Job Description**
 Shape decisions that influence teams, leaders, and culture. In this role, you'll partner with senior stakeholders to deliver people initiatives that improve organizational performance and the employee experience. You'll operate in a fast\-paced, highly collaborative environment and work closely with specialist partners to deliver consistent outcomes. If you bring strong judgment, data\-driven thinking, and comfort with complexity, you'll find meaningful scope and impact here.
   

  

 As a Human Resources Business Advisor, India Branch, Vice President in Human Resources, you will partner with senior leaders and colleagues to align people priorities with business objectives across India Branch. You will advise on talent, organizational effectiveness, culture, workforce planning, and employee relations topics with sound judgment and discretion. You'll collaborate across specialist teams to deliver a consistent employee experience while supporting local governance and people risk management. You would also be supporting the HR regulatory agenda for the Branch.
   

  

 Job responsibilities
   

  

* Partner with leaders and Human Resources colleagues to execute talent, organizational, and workforce strategies aligned to business objectives
* Advise on organizational design, workforce planning, succession planning, and talent development priorities
* Guide managers through performance management, talent reviews, development planning, and retention actions
* Provide employee relations guidance by assessing risk, recommending actions, and coaching managers through complex situations
* Coordinate with specialist partners to deliver people programs, leader enablement, and a consistent employee experience
* Analyze workforce trends and people metrics to identify issues, root causes, and improvement opportunities
* Support compensation and promotion processes through strong governance, manager education, and data quality discipline
* Promote inclusive practices and support diversity, opportunity, and inclusion efforts within the employee experience
* Apply external market intelligence and trends to inform people strategy and practical solutions
* Maintain appropriate controls, documentation, and oversight across critical Human Resources processes in line with local governance expectations
* Build strong stakeholder relationships across businesses, functions, and regional/global partners to drive execution


**Required Qualifications, Capabilities, And Skills**
* Bachelor's degree or equivalent practical experience
* Minimum 8 years of relevant Human Resources experience, including partnering with business leaders on people initiatives
* Demonstrated experience across talent management, employee engagement, organizational effectiveness, and workforce planning
* Demonstrated experience providing employee relations guidance and coaching managers through resolution
* Proven ability to influence and build credibility with stakeholders at multiple levels, including senior leaders
* Strong analytical and problem\-solving skills, including ability to use data and metrics to form recommendations
* Strong judgment, discretion, and ability to handle sensitive and confidential matters
* Excellent written and verbal communication skills with strong stakeholder management capability
* Demonstrated ability to manage multiple priorities in a fast\-paced, complex, and matrixed environment
* Strong project management and execution skills with attention to detail


**Preferred Qualifications, Capabilities, And Skills**
* Knowledge of India employment practices and the local regulatory environment
* Experience supporting leaders in a global organization with cross\-regional stakeholder partnerships
* Experience advising senior leaders on organizational and talent initiatives
* Familiarity with workforce analytics and data\-driven Human Resources practices
* Experience supporting governance activities such as audits, reviews, or risk and control routines related to people processes
* Prior experience partnering with teams across the Asia Pacific region

title: Human Resources Manager
description:
About Mita Realty:
 
 Mita Realty is a Mumbai\-based dynamic company offering a dual focus on real estate development and EPC (Engineering, Procurement, and Construction) solutions. They specialize in turnkey projects for residential, commercial, and mixed\-use properties, providing end\-to\-end services from design to final handover. They also focus on EPC solutions for heavy engineering and large\-scale infrastructure projects. Their operate largely in Maharashtra and Gujarat.
 



  




 About the Role:
 

 Mita Realty is looking for a hands\-on HR professional to run end\-to\-end HR for a construction and infrastructure business, covering both the corporate office and project sites. You will own the full employee lifecycle from hiring to exit, keep payroll inputs and statutory compliance accurate, and act as the link between management, project teams and site workforces. This is an independent role for someone who can run HR without close supervision, not only maintain attendance and files.
 




  




 Key responsibilities
 1. **Recruitment and manpower planning:** 
  Plan manpower with project and site heads, and run sourcing, interviews and offers for corporate, engineering and site roles.
2. **Onboarding and HR operations:** 
  Own joining, confirmation, transfer and exit processes, and maintain employee records and HR policies/SOPs.
3. **Attendance and payroll:** 
  Consolidate attendance, leave and overtime across Mumbai and Gujarat sites, verify payroll inputs with Accounts, and maintain records of advances and deductions.
4. **Statutory and labour compliance:** 
  Own compliance in both Maharashtra and Gujarat, including PF, ESIC, Professional Tax, Labour Welfare Fund, Shops \& Establishments, and the Contract Labour Act and BOCW framework for the site workforce. Coordinate with external consultants and keep registers and licences current.
5. **Site and labour coordination:** 
  Coordinate with the labour manager on manpower deployment, attendance and compliance for the site workforce, and be the HR point of contact for project managers and site engineers across sites.
6. **Employee relations and discipline:** 
  Handle grievances, run the disciplinary process end to end, and advise management on misconduct cases.
7. **Engagement and performance:** 
  Run engagement initiatives suited to office and site staff, and manage the appraisal cycle from goal\-setting through calibration.
8. **Exits:** 
  Manage resignations, clearances and Full \& Final settlement with Accounts.
9. **MIS and reporting:** 
  Publish a monthly HR dashboard covering headcount, joiners/leavers, attrition, absenteeism, open positions and compliance status, by location.



  




 Must\-have qualifications
 * 4\+ years of HR experience, with at least 2 years in construction, infrastructure, EPC or real estate development, including exposure to site workforces
* Working knowledge of labour law and statutory compliance in 
 **both Maharashtra and Gujarat** 
 : PF, ESIC, Professional Tax, LWF, Shops \& Establishments, Contract Labour Act, BOCW
* Hands\-on payroll ownership: verifying inputs and resolving payroll issues, not just forwarding attendance
* Experience running a disciplinary process end to end
* Strong Excel and HR MIS reporting skills
* Willingness to travel periodically to Gujarat


 KPIs
 
 Time to fill against approved manpower; payroll accuracy; statutory compliance across both states with zero penalties; joining/exit closure timelines; attrition and absenteeism trends; grievance resolution time; appraisal completion; monthly MIS on time.

title: HR Generalist
description:
**About Flexport:**
 At Flexport, we believe global trade can move the human race forward. That’s why it’s our mission to make global commerce so easy there will be more of it. We’re shaping the future of a $10T industry with solutions powered by innovative technology and exceptional people. Today, companies of all sizes \- from emerging brands to Fortune 500s \- use Flexport technology to move more than $19B of merchandise across 112 countries a year.
   

  

 The recent global supply chain crisis has put Flexport center stage as we continue to play a pivotal role in how goods move around the world. We are proud to have the support of the best investors in the game who believe in our mission, solutions and people. Ready to tackle global challenges that impact business, society, and the environment? Come join us.
   

  

**About The Role**
 We’re looking for an experienced HR Generalist, based in Mumbai, to own the full employee lifecycle and people programs across India and the Subcontinent. This is a true generalist role: you’ll run recruiting end to end, manage onboarding through offboarding, and drive the HR operations, compliance, and employee\-experience work that keeps our teams thriving. You’ll be the local face of the APAC People team, making sure our ambitious growth is supported by a robust and effective people strategy. We’re building a People function that works smarter with AI, so you’ll be encouraged to use modern AI\-powered tools to automate manual work, sharpen sourcing, and free up more time for the human side of HR.
   

  

**What You’ll Do**
* Own full\-cycle recruiting for a range of roles across departments \- building search strategies, sourcing active and passive candidates, screening, interviewing, and guiding candidates through hiring and onboarding.
* Track sourcing data to focus effort on the channels with the highest ROI, and partner closely with hiring managers to attract, assess, and close top talent.
* Drive proactive recruiting initiatives and help build the Flexport employer brand across the region.
* Communicate candidate pipelines, funnel metrics, and performance data clearly and regularly to internal stakeholders.
* Serve as the local representative of the APAC People team, enhancing employee experience across the full lifecycle from onboarding to offboarding.
* Lead local HR operations including data management, employee support, reporting and analytics, process improvement, payroll support, and policy development.
* Maintain accurate HRIS data in Workday, run audits, and resolve employee tickets.
* Leverage AI\-powered tools to automate repetitive HR tasks, source and screen candidates faster, and surface insights from people data.
* Act as the local expert on HR policy and ensure HR compliance across the region.
* Take on additional projects from the global and regional People leadership team as needed.


**What You’ll Bring**
* A BA/BS degree and 6\+ years of experience, including full\-cycle recruiting at a search firm or fast\-growing company.
* A strong track record of processing a wide range of HR transactions and a solid understanding of HR best practices across the APAC region.
* Proven ability to build rapport with hiring managers and cross\-functional partners at all levels.
* A creative approach to finding great people, with the ability to build candidate networks and channel connections.
* A drive for results \- you see processes through end to end and are motivated by data and metrics.
* Humility: no task is too big or too small.
* Excellent organizational skills and strong attention to detail.
* Hands\-on experience with Workday (HCM, recruiting, or reporting) is strongly preferred.
* Comfort adopting AI\-powered HR and recruiting tools, with curiosity about how AI can make people processes faster and better.


 Commitment to Equal Opportunity
   

  

 At Flexport, our ability to fulfill our mission of making global commerce easy and accessible relies on having a diverse, dedicated and engaged workforce. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment regardless of race, color, religion, sex, national origin, age, physical and mental disability, health status, marital and family status, sexual orientation, gender identity and expression, military and veteran status, and any other characteristic protected by applicable law.
   

  

 Global Data Privacy Notice for Job Candidates and Applicants
   

  

 Depending on your location, the General Data Protection Regulation (GDPR) and California Consumer Privacy Act (CCPA) may regulate the way we manage the data of job applicants. By submitting your application, you are agreeing to our use and processing of your data as required. Please see our Privacy Notice available at www.flexport.com/privacy for additional information.

The Business HR (BHR) is the HR Exco’s frontline representative embedded within the Retail Business Channel, directly accountable for two outcomes: building the zone’s sales and business capacity through disciplined, targeted hiring, and keeping that capacity productive and retained through active engagement, performance enablement and employee relations. The BHR converts central HR strategy – talent acquisition, HR operations, PMS, engagement and L\&D – into on\-ground zonal execution, and is the first point of accountability for the health, size and productivity of the zonal workforce.
 



  





 Locations \-
 **Mumbai , Bangalore, Hyderabad, Kolkata \& Delhi** 




  





**Key Responsibilities** 




**1\. Zonal Hiring \& Resourcing (Primary Accountability)** 




 •
 **Manpower Planning:** 
 Partner with Zonal / Regional Business Heads to translate business and revenue targets into monthly and quarterly hiring plans for sales and business roles.
 



 •
 **End\-to\-End Hiring:** 
 Own requisition\-to\-joining for the zone – sourcing (with Central TA’s Sales Hiring Lead), screening, structured interviews, offer negotiation and closure – for front\-line and mid\-level business hires.
 



 •
 **Vacancy \& TAT Ownership:** 
 Track and close open positions against defined TAT and cost\-per\-hire benchmarks; escalate sourcing bottlenecks to the Central TA team.
 



 •
 **Quality of Hire:** 
 Ensure hiring decisions are validated against role\-fitment and productivity benchmarks, not headcount alone; monitor early attrition and offer\-to\-join drop\-off as leading indicators of hiring quality.
 



 •
 **Internal Mobility:** 
 Identify and route internal talent for lateral moves and promotions within the zone before defaulting to external hiring.
 



  





**2\. Engagement, Retention \& Productivity (Primary Accountability)** 




 •
 **Engagement Ownership:** 
 Design and run a zonal engagement calendar (aligned to the central PMS \& Engagement framework) – connects, R\&R, team\-building – and track participation and pulse\-survey scores.
 



 •

*(Corporate Websites:* 
*www.agtfoods.com* 

 )
 




  




**Role Overview** 


 AGT Foods India and Umami Agro Industries are seeking an organized, execution\-oriented
 
**HR \& Admin Executive** 

 to manage dual\-entity Human Resources operations, employee lifecycle processes, statutory labor compliance, and administrative logistics.
 





 This role bridges corporate office personnel and factory\-level operations. You will handle recruitment coordination, onboarding/offboarding, payroll structuring inputs, employee relations, disciplinary procedures, quarterly/annual statutory compliance filings, actuary/audit query resolution, and executive travel/administrative support.
 




  




**Key Responsibilities \& Key Result Areas** 
**1\. Talent Acquisition \& Recruitment Operations** 
* Manage full\-cycle recruitment: source, screen, interview, and facilitate the hiring of qualified personnel across corporate, supply chain, and factory operations.
* Partner with departmental managers (Plant, Finance, Quality, Supply Chain) to define required competencies, interview scorecards, and role criteria.
* Conduct reference checks, background verifications (BGV), and candidate credential/eligibility checks.



  




**2\. Onboarding, Employee Lifecycle \& Documentation** 
* Facilitate new hire orientations and structured induction schedules for corporate staff and factory teams.
* Prepare official employment documentation: Offer Letters, Appointment Letters, Compensation Structures, Confirmation Letters, Increment Letters, Warning Notices, and Relieving/Experience Certificates.
* Execute smooth onboarding and exit formalities, including asset handovers, clearance certificates, and full \& final (F\&F) settlement documentation.
* Coordinate employee engagement, recognition programs, and workplace morale initiatives.



  




**3\. Compensation, Payroll Coordination \& Tax Administration** 
* Prepare standard CTC salary structures aligned with Indian statutory standards (PF, ESIC, Gratuity, PT, Professional Tax).
* Manage payroll inputs: attendance reconciliation, leave registers, overtime, and incentive data.
* Compute and monitor payroll\-related statutory deductions, including TDS on salaries, Gratuity accruals, and issuance of monthly Pay Slips and annual Form\-16\.
* Consolidate employee benefit data, compile inputs for annual
 
**Actuary Valuation Reports** 

 , and resolve HR\-related audit queries for internal/statutory auditors.



  




**4\. Statutory Labor Compliance \& Factory Registrations (Quarterly \& Annual)** 
* Maintain complete compliance with national, Maharashtra state, and local employment laws and labor regulations.
* Prepare, reconcile, track, and file mandatory quarterly and annual returns, registrations, and renewals across both corporate and manufacturing entities:
* Factory Act \& Factory License Registrations / Returns
* Maharashtra Shop \& Establishment Act
* UDYAM Registration (MSME Compliance)
* Maharashtra Labour Welfare Fund (MLWF)
* POSH (Prevention of Sexual Harassment) Annual Reports \& Internal Committee Records
* Payment of Bonus Act
* Maternity Benefit Act
* Payment of Wages Act \& Minimum Wages Act
* Maintain statutory registers (Muster Roll, Wage Register, Adult Worker Register, Accident Register, Leave with Wages).



  




**5\. Employee Relations, Policy Administration \& Plant HSE Support** 
* Serve as the frontline point of contact for employee inquiries, policy interpretations, and workplace grievances; escalate sensitive or complex matters to senior management.
* Participate in and document employee disciplinary inquiries, investigations, show\-cause notices, and termination proceedings in compliance with labor laws.
* Support Health, Safety \& Environment (HSE) administrative coordination, occupational health records, and workplace safety compliance alongside plant leadership.
* Stay updated on labor code trends, regulatory changes, and HR technology best practices.



  




**6\. General Administration \& Executive Travel Coordination** 
* Manage executive travel logistics for Directors and senior management: flight, train, and hotel reservations, web check\-ins, visa assistance, and itinerary tracking.
* Supervise corporate office administration, pantry/courier vendors, stationery inventory, and general office upkeep.



  




**Required Qualifications \& Competencies** 
* **Education:** 

 Bachelor’s or Master’s Degree in Human Resources Management, Business Administration (MBA/MSW/MHRM), Commerce, or a related field.
* **Experience:** 


**2 to 5 years** 

 of core HR and administrative experience, mandatory in a manufacturing, food processing, FMCG, or multi\-entity corporate setup.
* **Statutory Expertise:** 

 Direct exposure to Maharashtra labor laws, Factory Act, Shop \& Establishment, MLWF, POSH, and statutory return filings.
* **Payroll \& Tax Knowledge:** 

 Practical understanding of salary breakups, PF/ESIC portals, Gratuity calculations, and TDS on salary.
* **Technical Skills:** 

 Strong proficiency in MS Excel (VLOOKUP, Pivot Tables, tracker sheets), MS Office, ERP: Microsoft AX and D365 preferred, SAP, Odex, etc; and familiarity with HRMS/payroll software.
* **Communication \& Interpersonal Skills:** 

 Professional written and spoken English and Hindi; conversational fluency in Marathi is strongly preferred for local factory and labor authority liaison.
* **Organization \& Detail:** 

 Ability to handle dual\-company administrative workflows, confidential records, and deadline\-driven statutory filings with minimal supervision.

**About This Role**
**Job Purpose:**
 This hire will be part of the APAC Talent Acquisition Team, which is spread across Hong Kong, Singapore, Japan and India. The successful candidate will be accountable for experienced hires for our various business units in the region. They will be responsible for running end to end recruitment searches while ensuring all recruitment processes are adhered to for the business unit aligned. They will also work closely with our Global Talent Acquisition team in running and supporting global initiatives on an ongoing basis. This role will be based in Mumbai and will largely be focused on India talent acquisition. We are looking for a Talent Advisor who can partner with function leads on defining their recruiting strategy, execute roles while also providing market intelligence.
   

  

**Key Responsibilities**
* Technology and Analytics hiring for our India businesses. The role will involve working with multiple business units on complex technology roles.
* Advise the Business on best in class assessment methodology including supporting the businesses with relevant market data, insights and analytics as appropriate.
* Extensive partnership with Hiring Managers, Suppliers, Candidates and HR stakeholders to ensure Blackrock sources the best candidates in a timely and cost effective way \- leveraging market knowledge to offer superior advice on hiring approach and best execution.
* Deployment of direct sourcing techniques including leveraging employee referrals, job board advertising, and searching proprietary/external databases and social media for qualified candidates.
* Management of recruitment agencies and/or external search partners where appropriate.
* Help to promote “Internal First” culture by discussing internal talent options with hiring managers and being highly responsive to internal candidates.
* Work with Business Managers, Finance teams, HR Business Partners and Compensation Specialists to manage hiring plans, obtain appropriate hiring approvals and execute recruitment strategy.
* Design and deliver business specific hiring data/reports and presentations to inform and influence the business.
* Involvement in ad\-hoc projects within Talent Acquisition and across HR.


**Knowledge/ Experience Required**
* The ideal candidate should have at least 7\+ yrs of experience in Talent Acquisition having handled complex tech roles. Exposure to APAC recruiting a plus.
* Experience with volume recruiting is strongly preferred.
* Thorough understanding of hiring in domains like Technology, Asset Management \& Analytics is a must have.
* Experience of independently managing business unit hiring with high volumes
* Experience of working in a complex/matrix business structure is a pre\-requisite for the role.
* Exposure to various search practices and techniques– including the ability to approach candidates directly and provide ad\-hoc mapping and market intelligence.
* Advanced knowledge and experience of candidate closing skills/techniques.
* Experience of setting and communicating strategy, and a track record of delivering results.
* The ability to consult with and influence senior management.


**Competencies**
* Superior influencing, stakeholder and relationship management skills.
* Strong written and oral communication skills.
* A strong team ethic is key.
* A strong team player.
* Proven ability to manage multiple priorities while delivering high results.


**Our Benefits**
 To help you stay energized, engaged and inspired, we offer a wide range of benefits including a strong retirement plan, tuition reimbursement, comprehensive healthcare, support for working parents and Flexible Time Off (FTO) so you can relax, recharge and be there for the people you care about.
   

  

**Our hybrid work model**
 BlackRock’s hybrid work model is designed to enable a culture of collaboration and apprenticeship that enriches the experience of our employees, while supporting flexibility for all. Employees are currently required to work at least 4 days in the office per week, with the flexibility to work from home 1 day a week. Some business groups may require more time in the office due to their roles and responsibilities. We remain focused on increasing the impactful moments that arise when we work together in person – aligned with our commitment to performance and innovation. As a new joiner, you can count on this hybrid model to accelerate your learning and onboarding experience here at BlackRock.
   

  

**Guidance on AI use for candidates**
 At BlackRock, AI has long been part of how we work – enhancing decision\-making, improving operations, and helping us deliver better outcomes for clients. We encourage candidates to use AI thoughtfully to learn, prepare, and work more effectively; but during our interview process, we want to focus on getting to know you through your own experiences, thinking, and judgment. title: Business Head (Social Pharma Space)
description:
The Commercial Excellence Director is a broad, generalist role supporting commercial and business operations engine. The candidate works cross\-functionally across Sales, Marketing, Finance, Supply Chain and Group Operations, moving fluidly between analytics, strategy, and execution as business priorities shift.
 



  





 The role suits a strong generalist with a consulting, investment analysis, or startup operating background who can take ownership of ambiguous problems without needing a fixed brief.
 



  





**Key Responsibilities** 




 This is a broad, cross\-functional role built for someone who can pick up any commercial or operational priority as it comes up, working closely across Sales, Marketing, Finance, Supply Chain and Group Operations. Areas of focus are not limited to any fixed list, but typically include:
 



  




* **Leadership \& Strategy Support:** 
 Support the Head of India and leadership team on key commercial initiatives, strategic projects, and business priorities. Partner closely with leadership to drive commercial excellence initiatives.



  




* **Growth \& Partnerships:** 
 Drive business development and licensing, portfolio strategy, innovative partnerships, and other growth\-oriented tasks.



  




* **Cross\-Functional Coordination:** 
 Drive cross\-functional projects and initiatives by coordinating and collaborating with Sales, Marketing, Finance, Supply Chain, Operations, and Technology teams.



  




* **Execution \& Operations:** 
 Lead execution of key initiatives, action items, and business improvement plans. Support the optimisation of commercial processes, systems, CRM, and reporting frameworks.



  




* **Analytics \& Performance Tracking:** 
 Analyse business performance and develop insights to support data\-driven decision\-making across functions. Track key commercial and sales performance metrics, identify trends, and recommend improvement opportunities.



  




* **MIS \& Reporting:** 
 Develop and own MIS reports, dashboards, and performance scorecards for leadership.



  




* **Planning \& Financial Analysis:** 
 Lead business planning, budgeting, forecasting, and performance reviews. Evaluate the effectiveness and ROI of commercial initiatives, sales programs, and marketing activities.



  




* **Market Intelligence \& Executive Support:** 
 Conduct market research, competitive analysis, and business intelligence to support strategic decisions. Prepare presentations, business cases, and recommendations for senior leadership.



  





*Note: The scope will evolve with business needs — the right candidate is someone who can move fluidly between analysis, execution, and leadership support, rather than staying within a fixed job description.* 




  





 Qualifications \& Experience
 


* **Education:** 
 Ideally MBA from a reputed business school / post\-graduation preferred.
* **Experience:** 
 Minimum 8 years of experience, ideally including strategy consulting or investments.
* **Industry Context:** 
 Prior pharmaceutical, healthcare, or health\-tech startup experience strongly preferred.
* **Skills:** 
 Strong analytical and financial skills, with comfort operating across ambiguous, cross\-functional problems.

* Act as the primary liaison between Mumbai employees and the broader People \& Culture function, ensuring global programmes are localised effectively and employee needs are surfaced to APAC and global HR leadership.
* Represent the Mumbai Centre’s people priorities in regional and global HR forums, contributing to APAC\-level HR planning and programme design.


- 

**Employee Experience \& Engagement**
* Design and drive employee engagement strategies for the Mumbai Centre — diagnosing root causes of attrition and disengagement through structured listening, pulse surveys, stay interviews, and manager feedback channels.
* Champion inclusion, recognition, and psychological safety across Mumbai teams; partner with managers on effective onboarding, integration, and long\-term retention of critical talent.
* Lead the Mumbai Centre’s response to Employee Satisfaction Survey (ESS) results — developing and tracking location\-specific action plans with measurable outcomes.
* Build a strong sense of community and belonging at the Mumbai Centre through engagement initiatives, milestone recognition, and a vibrant culture calendar.


**Performance \& Talent Management**
* Guide Mumbai managers through performance calibration, feedback frameworks, PIPs, and improvement planning — coaching leaders to build high\-performing, accountable teams.
* Lead talent management processes for the Mumbai population including annual talent reviews, succession planning, career development conversations, and high\-potential identification.
* Partner with Talent Acquisition on workforce planning, role architecture, and hiring strategies that meet Mumbai Centre growth objectives.
* Advise on grade structures, career ladders, and compensation benchmarking specific to Mumbai talent markets, working through exception approvals where required.


**Employee Relations \& Compliance**
* Navigate complex employee relations matters with sound judgement, cultural sensitivity, and full alignment to Indian employment laws — including the Labour Codes, POSH Act, Shops \& Establishments Act, and relevant Maharashtra\-specific regulations.
* Ensure the Mumbai Centre remains audit\-ready and compliant across all HR documentation, statutory obligations, and internal policy adherence.
* Manage POSH implementation at the Mumbai location — including ICC constitution, awareness sessions, case management, and reporting.


**HR Data, Analytics \& Insights**
* Build and maintain a robust HR data dashboard for the Mumbai Centre — tracking headcount, attrition, engagement scores, hiring velocity, tenure, and capability metrics on a regular cadence.
* Leverage AI tools and data analytics platforms to identify workforce trends, predict attrition risk, and surface actionable insights for business and HR leadership.
* Present people data in a compelling, visually clear format to Mumbai business leaders and the APAC HR Leader — translating numbers into narrative and recommendations, not just reports.
* Contribute to APAC\-level people analytics initiatives, ensuring Mumbai data is accurate, structured, and integrated into regional reporting.


**Organisational Design \& Change Management**
* Lead and support organisational design, workforce restructuring, and change management initiatives for the Mumbai Centre — ensuring business\-driven decisions are executed with care for employee impact and regulatory compliance.
* Collaborate with COEs — Compensation, L\&D, Talent Acquisition, and HR Ops — to localise and deploy people programmes tailored to the Mumbai workforce.


**Required Skills**
* Strong HR generalist background with demonstrated depth across the full employee lifecycle — not limited to one HR function.
* Proven stakeholder management and influencing skills — able to advise, challenge, and partner with senior business leaders with confidence.
* Hands\-on knowledge of Indian employment law, including the Labour Codes, POSH Act, and Maharashtra\-specific statutory requirements.
* Proficiency in HR data analytics — comfortable working with HRIS data, building dashboards, interpreting workforce metrics, and presenting insights to leadership.
* Familiarity with AI tools and data visualisation platforms (e.g., Power BI, Tableau, Excel advanced analytics, or equivalent) applied to HR use cases.
* Strong presentation and storytelling skills — ability to translate complex people data into clear, decision\-ready narratives for senior audiences.
* Proficiency in HRIS platforms, particularly Workday.
* Skilled in change management, facilitation, and communication across seniority levels.
* Exceptional problem\-solving and organisational skills; able to manage multiple priorities in a fast\-paced, high\-growth environment.
* Outstanding verbal and written communication skills in English.


**Education \& Experience**
* Bachelor’s degree in Human Resources, Business Administration, Psychology, or a related field; MBA or Master’s in HRM strongly preferred.
* SHRM\-SCP, PHR, or equivalent professional HR certification is an advantage.
* 9\+ years of progressive HR experience, with at least 4–5 years as a standalone HR generalist or HRBP in a technology, FinTech, or product\-led organisation.
* Demonstrated experience managing the full HR mandate at a location or business unit level — not limited to a single HR function.
* Prior experience working in a global or multi\-geography organisation; exposure to APAC HR practices is an advantage.
* Proven ability to work independently and navigate ambiguity without a large HR team around them.
* Experience with HR data analytics, dashboard building, or people reporting in a structured business environment.


**Employee Benefits**
* Employee Health Insurance and Wellness program
* Maternity and paternity leave.
* Competitive salary, benefits, and special allowances.
* Continual learning and development opportunities for career growth.

title: Chief of Staff - Human Potential
description:
**About the Company** 




 Who we are At The Whole Truth, our mission is to ‘re\-build the world’s trust in its food’. We believe consumers have lost trust in big\-food companies because they’ve been selling half\-truths for ages. We believe the only way to remedy this, is for someone to stand up and speak the whole truth. What we do We are India’s first (and perhaps only) 100% Clean Label food company. What that means is we make food so clean, (only) we can declare each ingredient proudly upfront. \#nothing to hide.
 



  





**Why this role exists** 




 The HP function at TWT has a broad mandate \- build the organisation and leadership capability required for our next phase of scale, while continuing to deliver reliably on the fundamentals.
 



 As the agenda grows, the challenge is not a shortage of ideas or initiatives. It is ensuring that we are working on the few things that matter most, that ownership is clear, that decisions get made and stay made, and that commitments translate into execution on the ground.
 



 The Chief of Staff exists to make the CHPO and the HP leadership team more effective.
 



 The role will create the operating system through which the function runs: translating priorities into plans, creating the right forums and information flows, identifying where execution is getting stuck, driving decisions and follow\-through, and taking on a small number of strategic problems that cut across the function or organisation.
 



 This is not an EA role, nor is it a shadow HRBP or programme\-management role. The Chief of Staff does not take accountability away from functional owners. The role makes ownership clearer and execution stronger.
 



  





**What you will own** 




 The HP operating system
 


* Translate the HP strategy and OKRs into a small number of clearly owned priorities, milestones and outcomes.
* Design and continuously improve the operating cadence of the function \- leadership reviews, HRBP/TA/Ops forums, monthly operating reviews and quarterly and annual planning.
* Ensure every forum has a clear purpose: information, discussion or decision, with the right people in the room.
* Build one integrated view of HP priorities, decisions, dependencies and commitments.
* Ensure actions and decisions close; surface slippage and unresolved dependencies early rather than after deadlines are missed.
* Run the quarterly OKR/planning rhythm and ensure learning from one cycle informs the next.



  





**CHPO effectiveness and decision support** 




  




* Help the CHPO determine where to spend time and organisational attention.
* Bring structure to ambiguous issues before they become meetings or projects.
* Ensure important conversations arrive with the right context, data, options and trade\-offs.
* Synthesise employee signals, people data, business context and external perspectives into clear points of view.
* Track important decisions made by the CHPO/HP leadership team and ensure they translate into action.
* Act as a trusted thought partner who can challenge assumptions and bring an independent perspective.



  





**Cross\-functional execution** 




 Many important people priorities sit across HRBP, TA, Ops, Finance and functional leadership rather than neatly within one team
 



  





**The Chief of Staff will:** 



* Establish clear ownership and interfaces for these priorities;
* bring the relevant teams together when dependencies need resolving;
* identify open loops and escalate where necessary;
* hold owners to commitments without becoming the owner of their work;
* step in more deeply where an initiative is particularly critical, ambiguous or stuck.



  





**Strategic and OD priorities** 




 Alongside running the HP operating system, the Chief of Staff will personally lead a small number of high\-priority initiatives where there is no obvious natural owner or where the CHPO needs additional problem\-solving capacity.
 



  





**These could include:** 



* Leadership and top\-team effectiveness interventions;
* culture and ways\-of\-working initiatives;
* manager effectiveness;
* employee listening and organisational\-health interventions;
* AI and technology leverage within HP;
* compensation/rewards research and benchmarking alongside specialist partners;
* strategic talent or people\-process redesign;
* emerging organisational questions created by TWT's growth.



  





 The portfolio will change as the organisation changes.
 



  





 HRBPs remain accountable for understanding their organisations and developing the first point of view on talent and organisation design. The Chief of Staff can bring methodology, analysis and execution support where a problem cuts across the organisation.
 



 AI and productivity
 



  





**AI and productivity** 




  




* Identify where AI can fundamentally improve the way the HP function works rather than simply automate existing processes.
* Experiment with practical use cases across recruiting, employee listening, analytics, knowledge management, manager enablement and HP operations.
* Build solutions with the relevant functional owner and help successful experiments become part of normal ways of working.
* Continually ask where HP can deliver the same or better outcomes with less manual effort.



  





**What we are looking for** 




**Essential** 



* **6–10 years of experience** 
 in consulting, strategy, business operations, Chief of Staff roles, transformation/programme leadership or people/organisation strategy.
* Evidence of having taken complex, cross\-functional priorities from ambiguity through to execution.
* Exceptional structured problem\-solving and ability to separate what matters from what doesn't.
* High execution discipline and attention to detail without becoming process\-heavy.
* Ability to influence and hold senior stakeholders accountable without formal authority.
* Strong analytical ability and comfort using data to form a point of view.
* Excellent written communication \- able to turn complexity into a sharp one\-page note rather than a 30\-page presentation.
* Judgement and discretion appropriate to operating close to sensitive organisation and talent issues.



  





**Strongly preferred** 



* Experience in a high\-growth, founder\-led or rapidly changing organisation.
* Exposure to organisation effectiveness, leadership development or people strategy.
* Experience designing management cadences, OKRs or operating systems.
* Strong curiosity about technology and AI and its implications for how organisations and functions operate.



  





**The person we are looking for** 



* Someone who can operate at 30,000 feet and 30 feet in the same day.
* Someone who can help shape an important organisation question in the morning, challenge an unclear OKR in the afternoon, and later ask why something we committed to three weeks ago is still open.
* Someone who is low on ego, high on judgement and comfortable operating through influence rather than authority.
* And, most importantly, someone who understands that their job is not to do everyone else's work.
* Their job is to create enough clarity, discipline and momentum that the organisation gets the work done.

title: Apprentice - HR
description:
**Some Careers Open More Doors Than Others.**
 If you’re looking for a career that will unlock new opportunities, join HSBC and experience the possibilities. Whether you want a career that could take you to the top, or simply take you in an exciting new direction, HSBC offers opportunities, support and rewards that will take you further.
   

  

**People, Governance \& Communications**
 This team leads the implementation of the Group’s people strategy in line with our business objectives. It facilitates talent management, succession planning, and employee mobility while defining and overseeing frameworks that support employee performance management, reward, learning and development, resourcing and engagement.
   

  

**Job Description**
**Why join us?**
* The Human Resources (HR) team supports the people strategy by providing expert advice and guidance on the development, implementation, and ongoing review of key HR programmes and policies.


**The Opportunity**
* The incumbent will be responsible for working to support the delivery of the team’s strategic priorities and managing the overall agenda for their client groups to enable business performance.
* This includes providing support on recognition, global mobility, employee benefits, wellbeing, vendor management, reporting to support the Bank’s strategic objectives and local business priorities.


**What You’ll Do**
* Liaise with colleagues from across the organization to support priorities related to recognition, global mobility, employee benefits, wellbeing, vendor management and reporting
* Work with internal colleagues and vendors and suppliers to ensure the successful implementation of initiatives, processes and products in line with business objectives
* Develop specialist knowledge by keeping abreast of internal policies, competitor practice, external market developments and trends, and legislative and regulatory developments
* Translate data and reporting into analysis by interpreting the data and providing insights


**Qualifications**
* Graduate degree


**What You Will Need To Succeed In The Role**
* Effectively managing stakeholders and ensuring appropriate alignment between local and global practices and requirements
* Managing multiple priorities and adherence to timelines while dealing with ambiguity and navigating complex processes
* Highly proactive, ability to work in a matrix environment including colleagues in global, regional and country teams


**What additional skills will be good to have?**
* Strong collaboration skills with the ability to engage a diverse stakeholder group, including senior populations
* Strong track record of analytical skills, ability to interpret and to draw insights from data and present effectively to stakeholders
* Strong business acumen with ability to apply critical analysis and judgment when reviewing activities


 As an employee, you are required to perform your duties in a professional capacity exercising independent judgement, discretion and decision\-making authority in planning, organising, directing work, supervising and appraising the work of team members, as applicable; and taking accountability for delivery outcomes. You will represent the organization with relevant internal and external stakeholders. You will allocate and prioritize work, provide direction and feedback, manage team capacity and leave in line with policy as applicable.
   

  

**Additional Notes :** 
 Familiarity with AI\-enabled tools is an advantage.
   

  

**Additional Information** 
 The tenure of the Apprentice will be 1 (one) year as defined under Apprentices Act, 1961 and Apprenticeship Rules 1992 amended from time to time.All Apprentices engaged by the Bank will also be featured in NATS portal as an ‘Apprentice’. By virtue of them being covered under the provisions of the Act, a candidate profile will be created for each apprentice in the NATS portal, which will be available to them for viewing.On completion of the one\-year Apprenticeship tenure, a Certificate of Proficiency will be issued to the apprentice by the Govt. of India, as applicable under the Act and the enrollment under the Apprenticeship Act will cease.All other clauses regarding the tenure of engagement as an Apprentice with HSBC will stand as mentioned in the offer letter issued by the Bank at the time of joining.
   

  

 You’ll achieve more at HSBC.
   

  

 HSBC is committed to building a culture where all employees are valued, respected and opinions count. We take pride in providing a workplace that fosters continuous professional development, flexible working and opportunities to grow within an inclusive and diverse environment.
   

  

 Personal data held by the Bank relating to employment applications will be used in accordance with our Privacy Statement, which is available on our website.
