title: Associate Practice Director - Professional Services ( SaaS - HR Technology )
description:
**We're looking for a** 
****Associate Practice Director \- Professional Services ( SaaS \- HR Technology )****
**This role is** 
**Office Based**
**Associate Practice Director – Professional Services \| SaaS – HR Technology \| Mumbai**
**Role Overview**
 The Practice Director is a senior, strategic, and highly execution\-oriented techno\-functional leader responsible for the growth, performance, and evolution of a Professional Services practice.
   

  

 This role requires a leader who can operate confidently at both the strategic and operational levels—setting the direction for the practice while remaining close enough to the technology, product, customer, and delivery landscape to make sound decisions and unblock complex engagements.
   

  

 The Practice Director will own practice strategy, portfolio performance, delivery excellence, customer outcomes, talent development, and the evolution of scalable service offerings. They will play a critical role in translating Workforce AI capabilities, customer needs, and business priorities into practical, differentiated, and scalable services.
   

  

 A key expectation of this role is the ability to lead in an evolving AI landscape. The successful candidate must bring demonstrated experience in Workforce AI and practical AI capabilities, with a strong understanding of how AI can transform workforce processes, customer outcomes, and Professional Services delivery.
   

  

 Working closely with Professional Services, Sales, Customer Success, Product, Engineering, Alliances, and Support, the Practice Director will shape strategy, influence product and services direction, resolve critical customer and delivery challenges, and build a high\-performing organization capable of executing at scale.
   

  

**In This Role You Will**
 Practice Strategy \& Growth
   

  

 Define and execute the practice strategy, operating model, governance, and service portfolio in alignment with business priorities and market opportunities.
   

  

 Translate Workforce AI capabilities and evolving customer needs into scalable service offerings, implementation approaches, and advisory services.
   

  

 Drive the evolution of the practice through new offerings, improved delivery models, differentiated capabilities, and strategic investments.
   

  

 Partner with Sales and Customer Success to shape strategic opportunities, strengthen value propositions, and support practice growth.
   

  

 Portfolio \& Delivery Leadership
   

  

 Own the overall health and performance of the portfolio, including revenue, margin, utilization, delivery quality, customer satisfaction, risk, and strategic commitments.
   

  

 Establish strong operating rhythms and governance to identify risks early and drive timely corrective action.
   

  

 Provide senior leadership and direction for complex, high\-risk, or strategically important customer engagements.
   

  

 Ensure delivery teams maintain a strong focus on customer outcomes, time to value, quality, and sustainable adoption.
   

  

 Techno\-Functional \& Customer Leadership
   

  

 Serve as a senior techno\-functional authority for complex customer engagements, connecting business objectives with product capabilities, solution design, integrations, implementation complexity, and delivery strategy.
   

  

 Provide strategic guidance during complex pursuits, helping shape solution approaches, estimates, assumptions, risks, and customer outcomes.
   

  

 Build trusted relationships with senior customer stakeholders and serve as an executive escalation point when required.
   

  

 Lead critical customer and delivery escalations with urgency, sound judgment, and clear accountability through resolution.
   

  

 Cross\-Functional Leadership
   

  

 Partner closely with Product and Engineering to provide market and customer insights, influence priorities, and address product or capability gaps affecting customer outcomes.
   

  

 Work across Sales, Customer Success, Support, Alliances, and regional Services leadership to ensure strong alignment from opportunity through delivery and value realization.
   

  

 Drive clear ownership and accountability across complex cross\-functional dependencies.
   

  

 People \& Organizational Leadership
   

  

 Build and lead a high\-performing organization of Practice Managers, architects, consultants, and delivery leaders.
   

  

 Set a high bar for leadership, accountability, technical depth, execution, and customer ownership.
   

  

 Develop future leaders through coaching, mentoring, succession planning, and targeted capability development.
   

  

 Create an environment that combines strategic thinking, operational discipline, innovation, and strong execution.
   

  

 AI \& Workforce Transformation
   

  

 Bring practical experience and thought leadership in Workforce AI and AI\-enabled workforce transformation.
   

  

 Shape how AI capabilities are positioned, implemented, adopted, and operationalized for customers.
   

  

 Drive the responsible adoption of AI across Professional Services, including use cases that improve productivity, delivery quality, insights, risk visibility, and decision\-making.
   

  

 Establish practical AI\-enabled ways of working while ensuring appropriate governance, human oversight, quality controls, security, and responsible use.
   

  

**You’ve Got What It Takes If You Have**
 10–15\+ years of progressive experience in Professional Services, consulting, SaaS, enterprise technology, or digital transformation, including significant leadership responsibility.
   

  

 Demonstrated experience in Workforce AI, AI\-enabled workforce transformation, or enterprise AI solutions is required.
   

  

 Strong understanding of how AI can be applied to workforce strategy, skills, talent, learning, mobility, productivity, and organizational transformation.
   

  

 Strong techno\-functional depth, with the ability to move comfortably between business strategy, product capabilities, solution architecture, integrations, implementation complexity, and delivery execution.
   

  

 A proven ability to set strategy and personally drive execution—translating broad business priorities into clear plans, decisions, operating mechanisms, and measurable results.
   

  

 Demonstrated success leading a Professional Services practice, portfolio, business unit, or large delivery organization.
   

  

 Proven ownership of business and portfolio performance, including revenue, margin, utilization, productivity, delivery quality, customer satisfaction, and employee engagement.
   

  

 Experience shaping and scaling service offerings, delivery methodologies, governance models, and repeatable implementation approaches.
   

  

 Strong executive presence with the ability to influence customers and senior stakeholders and navigate complex, high\-stakes situations.
   

  

 Proven experience leading complex customer escalations and making timely decisions in ambiguous environments.
   

  

 A strong track record of building, developing, and retaining high\-performing teams across geographically distributed and matrixed organizations.
   

  

 Experience influencing and partnering effectively with Product, Engineering, Sales, Customer Success, and other senior cross\-functional leaders.
   

  

 Demonstrated experience applying AI to Professional Services delivery, with practical use cases across discovery, solution design, implementation, documentation, testing, knowledge management, reporting, and delivery insights.
   

  

 Strong understanding of responsible AI practices, including human oversight, quality controls, data security, governance, and adoption.
   

  

 Leadership Attributes We Are Looking For
   

  

**The Successful Candidate Will Be**
 Strategic, but highly execution\-oriented
   

  

 Technically credible and commercially minded
   

  

 Comfortable moving between executive conversations and delivery\-level detail
   

  

 Decisive and able to bring clarity to ambiguity
   

  

 A strong people leader who sets a high bar and holds teams accountable
   

  

 Customer\-focused, with strong ownership and a bias for action
   

  

 Comfortable challenging the status quo and driving change
   

  

 Passionate about Workforce AI and the practical application of AI to customer and business outcomes
   

  

**Preferred Qualifications**
 Experience in HR technology, talent management, learning, skills intelligence, workforce transformation, or enterprise HCM solutions.
   

  

 Experience delivering or consulting on AI\-powered workforce, talent, skills, learning, or employee experience solutions.
   

  

 Degree in Computer Science, Engineering, Information Systems, Business, or a related discipline.
   

  

 Relevant certifications in AI, cloud, enterprise architecture, project/program management, Agile, or Professional Services.
   

  

 Experience with CRM, Professional Services Automation, resource management, project management, and portfolio management platforms.
   

  

**Our Culture**
 Our mission is to empower people, businesses and communities. A culture created less by what we do and more by who we are. When people ask what our team is about, we point to our core values: champion customer success, bring our best, achieve together, get stuff done, and innovate every day. We're always on the lookout for new, curious and capable people who can help us achieve our goal and we are seeking diversity in the people who join our team. We want to make sure that our company reflects the demographic of our customers, clients, and the communities in which we operate. So if you want to work for a friendly, global, inclusive and innovative company, we'd love to meet you!
   

  

**What We Do**
 Cornerstone is a premier people development company. We believe people can achieve anything when they have the right development and growth opportunities. We offer organizations the technology, content, expertise and specialized focus to help them realize the potential of their people. Featuring comprehensive recruiting, personalized learning, modern training content, development\-driven performance management and holistic employee data management and insights, Cornerstone’s people development solutions are successfully used by more than 100 million\+ people in 180\+ countries and in nearly 50 languages.
   

  

 Cornerstone takes special care to ensure the security and privacy of the data of its users.
   

  

 Check us out on LinkedIn , Comparably , Glassdoor , and Facebook !

title: Personnel Officer
description:
Seaspan employees are goal\-driven and thrive in a high\-performance culture. Our integrated business model, with over 25 years of fleet life\-cycle management expertise, provides the world’s major shipping companies with long\-term leases on large, modern and technologically advanced vessels, combined with industry\-leading ship management services. As owner and operator of the vessels, we provide skilled officers and crews dedicated to the safe, reliable, and economical operation of our fleet. Seaspan's fleet has evolved over time to meet the varying needs of our customer base. We own vessels in a wide range of sizes, from 2,500 TEU to 24,000 TEU. Our main operating offices are located in Singapore, Vancouver, Hong Kong, and Mumbai.
   

  

**Position Description:**
 The Personnel Officer manages communications between management offices and sea staff, and coordinates with global port agents to ensure that crew on\-boarding and off\-boarding arrangements are performed efficiently in cost\-effective ports.
   

  

 This position works with the assistant personnel officer and crewing assistants to ensure that ‘fit to travel’ requirements are achieved and completed before sea staff is dispatched to company\-managed vessels.
   

  

**Job Responsibilities:**
* Is familiar with the Health, Safety, Environmental Protection and Quality Policy (PL\-005\), and understands the responsibilities under the Environmental Management System (EMS). In keeping with this and other compliance policies, they understand their duty to report any environmental noncompliance and/or concern to their manager or members of the senior management team (including the highest level of management) either directly or through the open reporting system as per Management System guidelines
* Ensures timely completion of required activities outlined before sea staff are dispatched, schedules sea staff pre\-joining briefings, and advises all parties with follow\-up reports
* Ensures logistics of sea staff and supernumeraries joining and offsigning are carried out promptly and communicated to agents, vessel, and others as required Works with the assistant personnel officer and crewing assistant to ensure that all crew relief nominations have valid documentation and met all visa requirements; also escalates pertinent concerns and issues onboard to relevant senior manager as required.
* Communicates with vessels and provides timely responses where possible;
* Arranges and reviews flag state documentation status of sea staff, ensuring compliance at all times; also applies for flag state dispensation where required
* Approves travel expenses and other vendor bills as applicable for officers joining or signing\-off and their supernumeraries (escalates exceptions to policy or costs which exceed signing authority)
* Prepares management reports where required
* Performs other duties as required.


**Requirements:**
* Graduate in any stream (three years university or equivalent)
* Minimum of three years of working experience in a shipping company,


 at least two of those years as an assistant personnel officer
   

  

* Proficiency with Microsoft Office suite
* Strong verbal and written communication skills, and good writing style
* Able to prioritize and multi\-task
* Attention to detail
* Good interpersonal skills with a customer focus


**Additional Desired Qualifications:**
* Previous sailing experience
* Experience in a multinational company


**Job Demands and/or Physical Requirements:**
* Availability via a mobile phoneoutside of office hours
* Periodic overtime to meet deadlines or accommodate time zone


 differences
   

  

 Seaspan Corporation is an equal opportunity employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to age, race, colour, religion, gender, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, disability, or protected Veteran status. We thank all applicants in advance. If your application is shortlisted to be included in the interview process, one of our team will be in contact with you.

* Handle filing, documentation and document tracking.
* Coordinate office supplies, stationery and basic administrative requirements.
* Assist in scheduling meetings and maintaining calendars.
* Coordinate with vendors, consultants and service providers when required.

* Maintain compliance calendars and renewal/expiry trackers.

* Strong organizational and documentation skills.
* Good knowledge of

 .
* Ability to maintain trackers and follow up systematically.
* Attention to detail and accuracy.
* Ability to handle confidential information responsibly.
* Good email and professional communication skills.

* Students pursuing

 , with strong follow\-up abilities. The candidate should be comfortable handling documentation and communicating with employees, consultants, vendors and professional advisors.

* Recruitment \& HR operations
* Employee documentation
* Office administration
* Corporate documentation
* Compliance tracking

title: Associate Manager – Human Resources (Employee Relations)
description:
**Position: Associate Manager – Human Resources (Employee Relations Manager)** 




  





  





**Job Role:** 
 Employee Relation, Human Resource Compliance, Grievance handling, performance management
 



**Location:** 
 Mumbai Thane (Vikhroli/Prabhadevi
 **)** 




**Work mode:** 
 Hybrid
 



**Qualifications:** 
 Graduate in any field
 



**Experience:** 
 6 – 12 years proven track record managing Employee Relation, Human Resource Compliance, Grievance handling, performance management
 



  





**About Willis Towers Watson** 




  





 Willis Towers Watson (NASDAQ: WTW) is a leading global advisory, broking and solutions company that helps clients around the world turn risk into a path for growth. With roots dating to 1828, Willis Towers Watson has 45,000 employees serving more than 140 countries and markets. We design and deliver solutions that manage risk, optimize benefits, cultivate talent, and expand the power of capital to protect and strengthen institutions and individuals. Our unique perspective allows us to see the critical intersections between talent, assets and ideas — the dynamic formula that drives business performance. Together, we unlock potential.
 



  





**About the role:** 




  




* The role serves as a trusted Human Resource and Employee Relations partner, providing strategic guidance on employee relations, workforce change, policy governance, regulatory compliance and employment\-related risk considerations. The role partners closely with business leaders and key stakeholders to support organizational effectiveness while ensuring an appropriate balance of business, people and compliance outcomes.
* Responsible for compliance with country/jurisdiction law and regulations for business as usual and when supporting the integration and harmonisation for any M\&A activity
* Partner with, Centres of Expertise and Global HR Operations to support the execution of enterprise and business programs in the region/country, as defined in the HR Service catalogue



  





**Roles and Responsibilities:** 




  





**HR support:** 




  




* Overall accountability for the management of country related HR matters and support to Country Business leaders and managers in line with local legislation, regulatory requirements and global HR priorities.
* Partner directly with senior business leaders to provide strategic HR and ER guidance, balancing business objectives, colleague experience and compliance considerations.
* Educate Country Business leaders and managers to undertake their responsibilities as defined in the HR Service Catalogue and Ways of Working



  





  





**Working Work Environment, Employee Relations and Compliance:** 




  




* Independently lead and manage complex ER matters including disciplinary issues, performance management, grievances, investigations, redundancies, workforce transitions, long\-term illness cases and negotiated exits. Provide guidance to colleagues and managers to achieve balanced and sustainable outcomes.
* Work with managers to provide effective coaching on managing performance and disciplinary issues, ensuring actions meet company and legislative requirements to maintain a positive and professional work environment for all colleagues
* Lead and negotiate exit agreements and separation arrangements, partnering with Legal where specialist advice or heightened risk considerations apply.
* Lead or support organizational change initiatives, including restructuring, workforce transitions, M\&A integration and policy harmonisation activities requiring country\-specific implementation, consultation and risk assessment.
* Maintain a strong understanding of employment laws, labour regulations and HR compliance requirements to identify risks, provide practical guidance and partner effectively with Legal on complex matters.
* Ensure adherence to unique jurisdictional requirements and monitor issues for continuous improvement of employment practices and/or processes.
* Lead the ongoing review, development and harmonisation of local HR policies, procedures and governance frameworks in line with legislative, regulatory and business requirements.
* Ensure the consistent practice and implementation of ER activities through the application of uniform policies, standard Operating Procedures, procedure, governance frameworks and documented templates.
* Serve as a local resource on work/life balance issues; coordinate with managers on alternative work arrangements and lead best place to work initiatives.
* In collaboration with other teams, some participation in locally required or relevant culture, wellness, disaster response or diversity initiatives that are aligned with global HR priorities.



  





**Performance and Talent Development:** 




  




* In line with the HR Service catalogue, partner with Talent Advisory to determine specific country support requirements for the execution of Talent programs, e.g. collective/individual consultation.
* Support the execution of CoE and Global HR Operations enterprise\-wide programs where there are country specific implementation requirements, e.g. collective consultation, legal restrictions.



  





**Integrated HR Service Delivery:** 




  




* Lead ER, compliance projects, managing multiple workstreams and coordinating with HR, Legal, Finance, Talent Acquisition, HRS, business leaders and global stakeholders to support successful delivery and effective risk management.
* Partner with CoEs to ensure global programs are executed in line with local legislation and consultation requirements
* Identify and implement opportunities for standardisation of work (e.g. HR process, service delivery) where appropriate.
* Utilize global HR technology, global processes and the tiered support model to support an integrated “One HR” organisation focused on the colleague and manager experience of HR services.



  





**Total Rewards:** 




  




* Provide Country specific support to the annual review cycle, specifically data validation as it relates to local policy requirements,
* Manage and oversee the administration of local benefits, including relationships with vendors and renewals, in line with market and legal requirements and in alignment with the Global Benefits strategy (where applicable)
* Partner with the Global Compensation and Benefits teams to support and provide advice relating to competitiveness of reward offerings and legislative changes impacting local programs, e.g. pay transparency, pay equity.
* Provide county specific support, as defined in the HR Service Catalogue, for internal movement of colleagues, including international transfers and relocations.



  





**Requirements:** 




  




* Strong hands\-on ER expertise with experience independently managing complex ER matters and investigations.
* Significant experience of partnering with senior business leaders on complex ER, workforce change and business\-critical people matters.
* Experience supporting organizational restructuring, workforce transitions, M\&A integration, policy harmonisation and other large\-scale change initiatives.
* Good understanding of employment laws, labour regulations, statutory compliance requirements and HR governance practices, with the ability to identify risks and partner effectively with Legal and Compliance teams.
* Excellent stakeholder management skills and experience working across business leaders, HR, Legal, Finance, Talent Acquisition, HRS and global teams.
* Strong project management and organizational skills, with the ability to manage multiple priorities, stakeholders and competing deadlines simultaneously.
* Ability to work independently, exercise sound judgment and balance business, people and compliance considerations when making recommendations.
* Experience operating within a complex global matrix environment and influencing stakeholders across multiple functions and geographies.
* Excellent written and verbal communication skills, including a good command of English.
* Ability to interact with colleagues at all levels.



  





  





**We’re committed to equal employment opportunity and provide application, interview and workplace adjustments and accommodations to all applicants. If you foresee any barriers, from the application process through to joining WTW, please email
 *candidatehelpdesk@wtwco.com.***

title: Head – Talent Management, L&D & Performance Management + HR Business Partner
description:
**Purpose** 




  





 This is a blended HR role, combining enterprise Talent Management, Learning \& Development and Performance Management ownership (approximately 60% of the role) with HR Business Partnering \+ Digital Transformation for defined business teams (approximately 40%). The role will drive SPNI's talent strategy, strengthen the leadership pipeline, succession, learning and performance management systems, while staying close to the business through hands\-on HRBP ownership \- bringing enterprise design and on\-ground execution together in one role.
 



 The ideal candidate will have core expertise and track record of driving Talent Management, L\&D and Performance Management, along with hands\-on HRBP experience and will be equally comfortable operating in both spaces. The candidate must be able to have a larger pan\-company perspective to design interventions and influence other BUs, while building deep business acumen and depth for the part of the business they directly partner.
 



**Key Responsibilities** 




**A. Talent Management, L\&D \& Performance Management** 



1. **Talent Management**



  




* Design the enterprise Talent Management strategy aligned to SPNI's business and growth priorities, by leveraging Build/Buy/Borrow levers.
* Talent 2 Value \- Develop strong business acumen and sector understanding to define high value roles in the company, closely linked to growth priorities. Design and implement a plan of action to ensure top talent is casted into these roles.
* Drive talent reviews, succession planning and identification \+ development of high\-potential talent across the organisation.
* Define the career framework for the wider organization including principles and guidelines for internal talent mobility, both horizontal and vertical career moves.
* Leverage Tech \& AI for new\-age talent management, with transparency, speed and consistency as key pillars.



  





  





  





  




1. **Leadership Development**



  




* Design and execute leadership development interventions across levels, with particular focus on current and future leaders.
* Build differentiated interventions for emerging leaders, high potentials and senior leadership. Partner with external leadership institutions, coaches and development partners where relevant
* Track the effectiveness and business impact of leadership development initiatives.



  




1. **Mission\-Critical Business Capabilities**



  




* Lead the Learning \& Development strategy across SPNI. Identify future\-critical capabilities on content, revenue and digital/technology in partnership with business and HR leaders
* Build learning journeys using a blend of formal learning, experiential learning, coaching, mentoring and digital interventions
* Ensure L\&D investments are aligned to business priorities and measurable outcomes.



  




1. **Assessments \& Talent Diagnostics**



  




* Leverage business insights, leadership feedback and data analytics to identify critical success factors for high performance at SPNI.
* Use this to design assessment methodologies using partnerships with assessment and talent diagnostic providers
* Ensure assessments translate into meaningful decisions on selection, advancement and development interventions for key talent.



  




1. **Performance Management \& Talent Processes**



  




* Own the enterprise Performance Management cycle end\-to\-end \- goal setting, mid\-year and annual reviews, ratings calibration \- in close partnership with HRBPs and business leaders
* Simplify and continuously improve the performance management framework, tools and calibration process
* Continuously evolve talent processes to make them simple, differentiated and business relevant
* Use talent data and insights to identify trends, risks and opportunities.



  





  





  





  




1. **Stakeholder Partnership \& Influence**


* Act as a trusted advisor to senior business leaders on talent and leadership matters Influence senior stakeholders without relying solely on formal authority
* External orientation and thought leadership – Get the best of knowledge and perspective from Sony Pictures global teams \+ external best practices in India to continuously challenge the status quo and sharpen SPNI’s HR practices and policies.



**B. HR Business Partnering** 



* Act as the HR Business Partner for a defined business group, providing end\-to\-end generalist HR support – strategic advisor, organization design, workforce planning and day\-to\-day people management
* Drive the local execution of performance management, compensation reviews and organisation/role changes for the aligned business
* Be the first point of contact for employee queries, policy interpretation and grievance resolution within the aligned business
* Drive engagement, culture and people initiatives for the business group
* Bring on\-ground business insight back into enterprise Talent Management, L\&D and Performance design, keeping enterprise frameworks grounded in real business needs



 More details on the business team for this candidate to partner will be shared in due course as we run this search.
 



**Key Metrics** 



* Succession coverage and leadership readiness for critical role
* Retention and progression of HiPos and critical talent
* Effectiveness and impact of leadership development and learning interventions
* Internal mobility and stakeholder satisfaction with talent processes.
* Employee relations TAT, resolution quality and query closure for the aligned business
* Engagement scores and attrition trends within the aligned business group



  





  





**Critical Competencies** 



* Strategic thinker with strong business acumen, curiosity and bias for execution
* Strong executive presence and stakeholder management to influence a wide group of senior leaders and rally the HR team on key interventions.
* External orientation \- Keep an eye on M\&E sector transformation, competitive intelligence, scan the world for best people practices and use this to design the SPNI HR innovation roadmap for the near\-term and medium \-term.
* Versatility to operate with equal comfort in enterprise\-level strategic design and in day\-to\-day, on\-ground business partnering



  





**Technical Competencies** 



* Talent Management \& Succession Planning
* Leadership Development, Learning \& Capability Building
* Talent Assessments, Psychometrics \& Development Centres
* Talent Reviews, HiPo, Career \& Internal Mobility frameworks.
* HR Business Partnering \- employee relations, engagement and generalist HR execution



  





**Ideal Candidate Profile** 



* 12–14 years of overall experience, with demonstrated excellence in Human Resources and at least 9–10 years of experience in Learning \& Development and Talent Management.
* At least 5 years of hands\-on HR Business Partnering experience, with strong business acumen and the ability to translate business priorities into people interventions
* Postgraduate qualification from a Tier I or Tier II institution.
* Excellent communication and stakeholder management skills, with strong executive presence.
* Strong ability to influence and convince leaders and business stakeholders, build alignment and secure buy\-in for talent, learning and people interventions.



 This role is best suited to someone who has deep, demonstrated expertise in driving Talent Management, Learning \& Development and Performance Management at an enterprise level, and who also brings meaningful hands\-on experience of partnering a strategic Business Unit. Candidates who have operated across both spaces \- with their core strength and track record in Talent Management/L\&D/Performance Management \- are ideally placed for this role.

The ideal candidate has hands\-on working experience with
 **Keka HRMS** 
 and brings strong process discipline, data accuracy, and stakeholder management skills to drive a fair, transparent, and well\-governed performance and rewards ecosystem.
   

  

**Key Responsibilities**
**Performance Management (≈70%)**

**Compensation \& Rewards (≈30%)**

* Assist in preparing and maintaining salary benchmarking data, compensation structures, and pay bands.

* Support administration of rewards and recognition programs, including tracking nominations, budgets, and payouts.
* Assist in variable pay/bonus calculations based on performance ratings and business/individual metrics.
* Maintain compensation data integrity in Keka and ensure compliance with internal pay equity guidelines.
* Support ad hoc compensation analyses (pay equity checks, attrition\-linked compensation trends, offer benchmarking) as required.

**Required Skills \& Experience**

* Strong understanding of performance management frameworks (goal\-setting, OKRs, competency\-based appraisals, bell curve/forced ranking, calibration).
* Working knowledge of compensation fundamentals — salary structuring, benchmarking, variable pay design, and increment/bonus cycles.
* Strong Excel/data analysis skills; comfort building dashboards and reports from HRIS data.
* Excellent stakeholder management — ability to work independently with managers, HRBPs, Finance, and leadership.
* High attention to detail and discretion in handling confidential compensation and performance data.
* Strong process orientation, ownership, and ability to manage multiple cycles/deadlines simultaneously, without relying on a team to execute.


**Good to Have**
* Prior experience in a listed/mid\-size organization with multi\-business\-unit structure.
* Exposure to designing or refining performance policies, competency frameworks, or reward programs.
* Experience preparing leadership/EXCO\-level dashboards and analytics.


**Qualification**
* Postgraduate in HR, Business Administration, or related field (MBA\-HR preferred).

 Won recognition as Indias best Fintech at the Financial Express Best Banks Awards. an award that was presented to our CEO by Smt Nirmala Sitharaman, Finance Minister, Govt of India.

title: Compensation Benefits Manager
description:
**Overview**
 CACTUS is a remote\-first organization and we embrace an accelerate from anywhere culture. For this critical role, we are looking for the candidate to be based in Mumbai. You may choose to work from home in Mumbai; however, you will be required to frequently travel to our Andheri East office for business requirements, meetings, or company/team events.
   

  

 We are looking for a passionate HR professional with advanced Excel skills, excellent comprehension and strong analytical depth — ideally with a background in Compensation \& Benefits or a COE analytics role — to join us as Manager, Compensation \& Benefits!
   

  

 As a Manager, Compensation \& Benefits, you will be the custodian of HR data. This is an individual contributor and hands on role. You will own the gathering, cleaning, collating and converting of data into accurate reports and dashboards for leaders and stakeholders within the organization, and go beyond reporting to independently analyse the data and deliver insight leaders can act on. You will play a pivotal role as the reports, dashboards and analysis you own will enable leaders to make informed \& data\-driven decisions that will shape the future of Human Resources at CACTUS! You will report to the AVP, HR Operations \& Administration.
   

  

**Responsibilities**
* Partner with stakeholders to understand the problem statement or objective, and independently shape the right analytical approach.
* Gather relevant data from various sources, databases, internal systems and combine data from multiple sources into a cohesive dataset using MS Excel.
* Bring compensation \& benefits context to HR analytics — support people cost, salary benchmarking and compensation revision cycle analysis with market and structural context from your COE background.
* Ask the right questions, comprehend and use advanced Excel techniques such as pivots, validation automation, formulas, macros among others to analyze \& interpret the data — going beyond the numbers to explain the 'why' behind the trends.
* Own the creation and continuous improvement of various reports and dashboards such as headcount \& attrition report, people cost reports, hiring \& ad\-hoc data reports etc.
* Independently draw meaningful conclusions from the analysis, summarize key insights \& recommendations, and partner with the AVP, HR Operations \& Administration to present these to leaders and stakeholders.


**Qualifications And Prerequisites**
* Bachelors in any discipline; bachelor's in engineering or mathematics, statistics is preferred.
* Demonstrated expertise in using advanced Excel techniques.
* Passionate about data with an affinity for numbers and metrics.
* 5–7 years of experience creating reports from scratch and analyzing HR\-related data, with prior experience in a Compensation \& Benefits function or COE strongly preferred.
* Excellent comprehension skills \& ability to ask the right questions, with a demonstrated track record of turning analysis into clear, actionable recommendations.
* Strong attention to detail.
* Good communication skills, with experience presenting insights confidently to leadership and stakeholders.


 Application Process
   

  

 Before applying, please ensure you meet the role requirements listed above and have legal authorization to work in the country where this role is advertised. Our selection process typically involves an initial screening by a recruiter, a technical assessment, and two to three interview rounds. For this role, you will have to work on an assessment followed by a virtual interview and lastly an in\-person interview at our Andheri East office.
   

  

**Equal Opportunity**
 Our hiring practices reflect our commitment to providing equal opportunities and creating an environment where everyone can thrive, develop, and succeed. We celebrate the uniqueness of our team members and prohibit discrimination of any kind, based on race, color, religion, gender identity, sexual orientation, age, marital status, disability, or any other protected characteristic.
   

  

**Accelerating from Anywhere**
 As a remote\-first organization, these are essential attributes we look for in all our candidates.
   

  

* Taking ownership of your work with minimal supervision, showing strong ability to organize, prioritize and deliver results independently.
* Documenting work that brings everyone on the same page.
* Maturity to choose between synchronous and asynchronous collaboration.
* Effectively collaborating with colleagues across different time zones by setting dedicated hours for collaboration and keeping team members updated through your MS Teams status.


**About CACTUS**
 Established in 2002, Cactus Communications (cactusglobal.com) is a leading technology company that specializes in expert services and AI\-driven products which improve how research gets funded, published, communicated, and discovered. Its flagship brand Editage offers a comprehensive suite of researcher solutions, including expert services and cutting\-edge AI products like Mind the Graph, Paperpal, and R Discovery. With offices in Princeton, London, Singapore, Beijing, Shanghai, Seoul, Tokyo, and Mumbai and a global workforce of over 3,000 experts, CACTUS is a pioneer in workplace best practices and has been consistently recognized as a great place to work.

* Conceptualize the right delivery approach for leadership and non\-technical topics
* Advise on program structure and flow to maximize participant impact
* Engage confidently with senior client audiences while collaborating with the central design team
* Conduct comprehensive needs analysis and drive continuous improvement measurement
* Maintain strong customer relationships and demonstrate expertise through recognized LDP certifications This role emphasizes world\-class virtual delivery, customer partnership, and data\-driven improvement—leveraging pre\-built curriculum and design support from the central team. Talent Development involves creating and implementing programs to enhance employees skills and career growth. This includes training, mentoring, and performance management. The goal is to help employees reach their full potential and contribute effectively to the organization. Responsibilities also include identifying skill gaps and developing strategies to address them. This role is essential for fostering a skilled and motivated workforce. Ensure successful delivery of learning solutions and review their effectiveness and applicability. What are we looking for?
* 5\-10 years of proven experience delivering leadership and communication training, preferably with US client exposure and scalable virtual delivery models.
* Minimum ONE recognized LDP certification (MBTI\-trained facilitator, Hogan certified, DDI trained, CliftonStrengths certified, Five Behaviors facilitator, or equivalent industry\-standard credential demonstrating specialized expertise).
* Demonstrated experience conducting needs analysis for training programs, including learner personas, organizational context assessment, and success metric definition.
* Multiple LDP certifications (e.g., MBTI \+ Hogan \+ CliftonStrengths combination) demonstrating depth of expertise.
* Experience with logistics\-specific leadership challenges, frontline team motivation, operational decision\-making, and supply chain context.
* Expertise in adaptive, blended, and personalized learning models; experience with learning technology and adaptive platforms.
* Track record of scaling training programs from pilot to enterprise level; experience managing multiple concurrent cohorts.
* Speaking experience at industry conferences, webinars, or training forums.
* Background in organizational development, change management, or executive coaching. Essential Skills \& Competencies 1\. Needs Analysis \& Discovery \- Ability to conduct structured interviews, design assessment frameworks, analyze organizational contexts, and translate insights into delivery design. 2\. Persona Development \& Adaptation \- Skill in creating learner personas, adapting communication style, and customizing examples and activities based on audience profiles. 3\. Measurement \& Data Analysis \- Comfort with training metrics, survey design, data interpretation, and translating findings into recommendations. 4\. Continuous Improvement Mindset \- Proactive approach to identifying enhancement opportunities, iterating on delivery, and documenting learnings for scaling. 5\. Customer Liaison \& Stakeholder Management \- Comfort presenting to C\-suite, gathering feedback, managing expectations, and building collaborative partnerships. 6\. Virtual Facilitation Excellence \- Mastery of virtual delivery techniques, participant engagement in distributed settings, time zone flexibility, and technical proficiency. 7\. LDP Framework Expertise \- Deep knowledge of behavioral, personality, or emotional intelligence assessment models; ability to integrate frameworks into training design and coaching. Roles and Responsibilities:
* Training Delivery \& Content Customization
* Conduct engaging, interactive virtual sessions on leadership and communication skills tailored for US logistics professionals (frontline supervisors to senior leaders).
* Perform comprehensive pre\-training needs analysis within 2 weeks of engagement kickoff to identify skill gaps, learner personas, organizational context, and delivery readiness.
* Customize training delivery and examples to address core logistics leadership topics: team collaboration, communication, problem\-solving, technology adaptability, resilience in operational disruptions.
* Cover relevant leadership skills from industry\-recognized Leadership Development Programs (LDPs): self\-awareness, team performance acceleration, effective feedback, resilience, trust\-building, leading with authenticity in complex environments.
* Leverage Training\-as\-a\-Service (TaaS) principles for scalable, interactive virtual training aligned with US business hours and operational realities.Persona\-Based Delivery \& Adaptation
* Conduct participant persona analysis (frontline supervisors, middle managers, senior leaders) to understand diverse learning needs, communication preferences, operational challenges, and success drivers.
* Adapt delivery style, examples, case studies, and facilitation methods based on persona\-specific requirements and organizational culture.
* Tailor pace, interaction methods, and breakout room activities to match learner profiles (e.g., high\-pressure operational leaders vs. strategic planning roles).
* Provide persona\-specific feedback and coaching to ensure relevance and on\-the\-job application for participant roles.LDP Expertise \& Professional Mastery
* Demonstrate mastery of at least one recognized Leadership Development Program framework (Hogan, DDI, CliftonStrengths, MBTI, Five Behaviors of a Cohesive Team, or equivalent).
* Apply personality, behavioral, and emotional intelligence assessment frameworks to training design and participant coaching.
* Integrate LDP frameworks into 100% of training modules as a performance expectation.

 This India \& AMET (Africa, Middle east and Turkey) Rewards Lead is a senior, strategic position based in Mumbai, designed to address the growing complexity and ambition of the rewards agenda across India and the AMET region (Including Tunisia, Egypt, Turkey, KSA and UAE countries). This role drives also the transformational projects shaping the future of rewards at OPELLA India, and operates at the intersection of strategic advisory, transformation leadership, and operational excellence across a broad and diverse geography.
   

  

**Main Responsibilities**
 This position plays a pivotal role in leading and elevating the OPELLA Rewards strategy across India and the AMET region, with a particular focus on driving transformational change initiatives, ensuring regulatory compliance as a listed entity, and providing senior\-level strategic guidance to the India P\&C Director, Leadership Team, and AMET business and HR leaders.

 Oversee and drive operational excellence across all rewards and performance activities for India \& AMET, including:

Provide data\-driven insights through dashboards and reporting tools to support leadership decision\-making.

Ensure full compliance with India \& AMET\-specific remuneration regulations, taxation requirements, and listed entity obligations.

We're looking for an HR / OD Consultant. But not the "write a policy manual" kind.
 



 This is a 4\-month project assignment. It is not a permanent position.
 



  





 At SHANBHAGS, we are in the middle of an important internal transformation.
 



 The vision is clear. The intent is clear. Now comes the harder part: making it real.
 



 Because organisations do not change because a presentation says they should. They change when intent translates into clear behaviours, operating disciplines, systems and SOPs that people can actually follow — and managers can actually manage.
 



  





 We are looking for a senior HR / Organisation Development Consultant who has done this before — at scale. Someone who can understand the organisation, work closely with leadership and employees, and help build the frameworks and SOPs that make the transformation live every day.
 



 Not just define what should happen. Design it. Implement it. Make it stick.
 



  





 You should bring:
 


* 10–15\+ years of serious HR / OD experience
* Proven experience designing AND successfully implementing organisation\-wide SOPs, operating frameworks and people/culture systems
* Experience working with large and complex organisations
* Ability to translate organisational intent into specific, practical, measurable and repeatable behaviours and processes
* Strong experience across performance management, capability building, accountability, leadership, cross\-functional working, employee development and culture implementation
* The ability to work with leadership while understanding what actually happens on the ground
* A healthy intolerance for beautifully written documents that collapse the minute real life begins



 One thing matters enormously: You must have implemented what you designed.
 



  





 This is not recruitment. Not an HR audit. Not policy polishing. And certainly not another employee handbook nobody reads. It is about helping us build the operating DNA for the next phase of Shanbhag Engineering Company.
 



  





 We also welcome former CHROs, HR Heads and senior OD leaders who may have stepped away from full\-time corporate life but still enjoy solving difficult organisational problems. Perhaps you no longer want the title or a 9\-to\-9 — but still miss rolling up your sleeves once in a while. For someone like that, this could be a very satisfying four months — a chance to solve a real organisational problem and build something that lasts well beyond the assignment.
 



  





 Interested? Write directly to hr@shanbhags.com with:
 


* A brief profile and relevant work experience

**Company Description** 
 Subko Specialty Coffee Roasters, Bakehouse and Fine Cacao is a purpose\-driven brand spotlighting specialty coffee, elevated baking, and fine cacao from the Indian Subcontinent. The company combines traditional “daily bread” culture with innovative, risk\-taking flavor profiles, crafting distinctive coffees, breads, viennoiserie, and cacao products. Subko’s mission is to build a genuinely Asian specialty coffee and cacao movement and represent the region on a global platform. Through a “Cherry to Cup,” “Crop to Craft,” and “Pod to Bar” ethos, Subko focuses on meticulous sourcing, processing, and production to set new quality standards. The team is driven by craft, curiosity, and a commitment to reshaping how people experience coffee, bakehouse offerings, and cacao.
   

**Role Description** 
 The Learning and Development Manager is a full\-time, on\-site role based in Mumbai, responsible for designing and leading learning initiatives across Subko’s coffee, bakehouse, and cacao operations. Day\-to\-day responsibilities include creating training curricula, facilitating workshops and on\-the\-job training, managing learning content and systems, and partnering with managers to build role\-specific capabilities. The Learning and Development Manager will collaborate closely with leadership to develop talent pipelines, support performance and leadership development, and ensure training aligns with Subko’s craft\-focused culture and growth plans. * Candidates should possess skills in Training and Instructional Design to create engaging, role\-relevant content and deliver effective in\-person sessions.
* Candidates should possess skills in Leadership Development to support manager capability\-building, succession planning, and talent growth.
* Experience with hospitality, food \& beverage, specialty coffee, or retail environments is beneficial.
* Strong communication, facilitation, and stakeholder management abilities, with a collaborative, hands\-on working style.
* Proven experience in a Learning and Development or similar HR role, preferably 4–7 years, with responsibility for end\-to\-end training programs.
* Bachelor’s degree in Human Resources, Education, Business, Psychology, or a related field; relevant certifications in L\&D or instructional design are an advantage.
* Comfort working on\-site in a fast\-paced, craft\-driven environment and aligning learning initiatives with business goals and brand values.

title: Process Manager
description:
**Job Description**
 The candidate must possess in\-depth functional knowledge of HR processes and apply it to operational scenarios to provide effective solutions. The candidate must be able to identify discrepancies and propose optimal solutions by using a logical, systematic, and sequential methodology. It is vital to be open\-minded towards inputs and views from team members and to effectively lead, control, and motivate groups towards company’s vision. Additionally, the candidate must be self\-directed, proactive and seize every opportunity to meet internal and external customer needs and achieve customer satisfaction by effectively auditing processes, implementing best people practices and process improvements, and utilizing the frameworks and tools available. Goals and thoughts must be clearly and concisely articulated and conveyed, verbally and in writing, to clients, colleagues, subordinates, and supervisors. The candidate should act as a change agent, acting as a catalyst to drive vertical/org. level changes.
   

  

**Responsibilities**
 Employee Engagement \& Issue Resolution
   

  

* Understand employee pulse through regular connects and raise concerns to the right stakeholders.
* Ensure employee issues are resolved end\-to\-end with quick turnaround.
* Conduct one\-on\-one connects with the Analyst–Manager pool during pulse checks.
* Govern leadership connect sessions for the program.
* Manage attrition for the program and implement retention actions.


 Performance Management
   

  

* Partner with Business for performance calibration discussions.
* Conduct sessions to educate employees on the Performance Management System.
* Ensure timely goal\-setting between managers and their teams.
* Guide and train managers on the evaluation process.
* Monitor and govern PIP/Performance Coaching for bottom performers.
* Close calibration cycles with Business.


 Career \& Capability Development
   

  

* Run career development and capability\-building programs for identified A–PM talent.
* Coach employees to take ownership of their growth.
* Oversee the 90\-day onboarding and assimilation journey for Analyst–Manager pool.


 Discipline \& Compliance
   

  

* Investigate any conduct\-related issues and close them with appropriate disciplinary action when required.
* Complete exit interviews for Analyst–Process Manager employees within timelines.
* Ensure timely closure of Bottom Quartile cases.
* Close background verification issues for Analyst–Process Manager employees in the program.


 Reporting \& Governance
   

  

* Keep all trackers updated, including pulse, discipline, conduct, and performance.
* Share updated trackers with the Senior HRBP and other stakeholders.
* Create and maintain reports and dashboards for all program\-related HR activities.
* Drive Rewards \& Recognition programs to appreciate employee contributions and boost performance.

* Graduate with an MBA
* 5\+ years of total experience, with at least 3 years as an HR Business Partner in a KPO / IT / ITES environment

* Comfortable managing multiple priorities and driving HR initiatives end\-to\-end.

 Fairmont Hotels \& Resorts is where the intimate equally coexists with the infinite – an unrivaled portfolio of more than 90 extraordinary hotels where grand moments of life, heartfelt pleasures and personal milestones are celebrated and remembered long after any visit. Since 1907, Fairmont has created magnificent, meaningful and unforgettable hotels, rich with character and deeply connected to the history, culture and community of its destinations – places such as The Plaza in New York City, The Savoy in London, Fairmont San Francisco, Fairmont Banff Springs in Canada, Fairmont Peace Hotel in Shanghai, and Fairmont The Palm in Dubai.  The incumbent will act as a strategic partner to the General Manager and Executive Committee, driving employee engagement, talent development, and operational excellence.

* Drive organizational development, workforce planning, and change management initiatives.

* Oversee recruitment and selection processes to ensure timely hiring of qualified candidates.
* Ensure adherence to approved manning budgets and organizational structure.
* Promote employer branding initiatives in line with Accor standards.
* Learning \& Development
* Implement training plans and development programs in line with Accor learning frameworks.
* Monitor training effectiveness and ensure compliance with mandatory training requirements.
* Identify high\-potential employees and support succession planning.

* Support department heads in goal setting, performance reviews, and development planning.
* Promote a performance\-driven culture with clear accountability.
* Employee Engagement \& Welfare
* Drive employee engagement initiatives to enhance satisfaction and retention.
* Ensure effective communication channels across all levels of the organization.
* Oversee employee welfare activities in line with company policies.
* Compensation \& Benefits
* Ensure proper administration of payroll, benefits, and statutory compliance.
* Maintain internal equity and external competitiveness of compensation structures.
* Monitor labor costs in line with budget guidelines.
* Employee Relations \& Compliance
* Manage employee relations issues, including grievances and disciplinary matters.
* Ensure compliance with applicable labor laws and Accor policies.
* Maintain positive relations with external authorities and stakeholders where required.

* Oversee HR administration, documentation, and record management.
* Ensure compliance with internal audits and corporate reporting requirements.
* Maintain HR systems and ensure data accuracy.

* Ensure implementation of Accor values and Heartist® culture across both properties.

title: Fleet Personnel Officer
description:
Seaspan employees are goal\-driven and thrive in a high\-performance culture. Our integrated business model, with over 25 years of fleet life\-cycle management expertise, provides the world’s major shipping companies with long\-term leases on large, modern and technologically advanced vessels, combined with industry\-leading ship management services. As owner and operator of the vessels, we provide skilled officers and crews dedicated to the safe, reliable, and economical operation of our fleet. Seaspan's fleet has evolved over time to meet the varying needs of our customer base. We own vessels in a wide range of sizes, from 2,500 TEU to 24,000 TEU. Our main operating offices are located in Singapore, Vancouver, Hong Kong, and Mumbai.
   

  

**Position Summary**
 The Fleet Personnel Officer provides comprehensive communication, project coordination, executive and administrative support to the Head of Fleet Personnel. The role is responsible for managing high\-volume correspondence, coordinating departmental projects, monitoring actions and deliverables, and supporting the effective functioning of the Head of Fleet Personnel’s office.
   

  

 The position also supports departmental reporting, governance, seafarer welfare initiatives, union and CBA administration, forums, travel and selected operational matters. It requires a high degree of discretion, sound judgement, attention to detail and the ability to remain responsive while coordinating with senior leaders, Fleet Personnel teams, vessels, seafarers, manning partners, unions, vendors and other stakeholders across different time zones.
   

  

**Key Responsibilities**
* Email, Communication and Correspondence Management: 20%
* Manage and organise the Head of Fleet Personnel’s high\-volume email correspondence, ensuring messages are reviewed, prioritised and directed appropriately.
* Identify matters requiring immediate attention, follow\-up, delegation or escalation, and maintain visibility of pending responses and commitments.
* Draft, proofread and coordinate emails, letters, memos, presentations and other communications on behalf of the Head of Fleet Personnel.
* Prepare standard departmental letters, invitation letters, confirmations and authorisation documents, and maintain appropriate records.
* Coordinate with internal and external stakeholders to obtain timely inputs and ensure correspondence is closed out accurately and professionally.
* Handle confidential, sensitive and privileged information with discretion.
* Project Coordination and Action Management: 20%
* Coordinate Fleet Personnel projects and improvement initiatives by maintaining project plans, milestones, actions, risks, decisions and deliverables.
* Proactively follow up with responsible stakeholders, identify potential delays and provide concise progress updates to the Head of Fleet Personnel.
* Coordinate user inputs, testing, communications and implementation follow\-up for Fleet Personnel systems and digitalisation initiatives, including COMPAS and related crew\-management processes.
* Support the preparation of project briefs, presentations, status reports, process guidance, memos and rollout communications.
* Liaise with IT, Finance, HR, Training, regional teams and other functions to resolve dependencies and support timely delivery.
* Remain responsive to urgent project requirements and changing priorities arising from Seaspan’s global operations.
* Meetings, Minutes and Follow\-up Coordination: 10%
* Coordinate meeting logistics and prepare agendas, briefing notes and supporting materials for departmental, management and external stakeholder meetings.
* Record and circulate clear minutes of meetings and maintain action trackers with owners and target dates.
* Follow up on overdue actions and provide the Head of Fleet Personnel with timely updates on progress and outstanding matters.
* Coordinate the Fleet Personnel weekly meeting agenda and consolidate inputs from departmental and regional teams.
* Support meetings across time zones when operationally required.
* Reporting, Dashboards and Management Information: 10%
* Prepare and maintain periodic reports, dashboards, management information and KPI trackers for the Head of Fleet Personnel.
* Gather and consolidate information from Fleet Personnel teams and company systems into structured summaries for leadership review.
* Support monthly management reporting, budget coordination, variance commentary and ad hoc analysis.
* Maintain accurate records of departmental actions, incidents, recognition, policy exceptions and other agreed metrics.
* Work accurately under tight timelines while managing multiple reporting requirements concurrently.
* CBA, Wage Scale, Vessel Data and Union Coordination: 10%
* Maintain trackers for Collective Bargaining Agreement renewals, vessel enrolments, correspondence and supporting documentation.
* Maintain controlled vessel and CBA data, including business unit, shipowner, flag, complement and applicable wage arrangements.
* Support the preparation, issue and recordkeeping of approved wage scales and related Fleet Personnel memoranda.
* Coordinate routine documentation and follow\-up with unions, manning partners and internal stakeholders under the guidance of the Head of Fleet Personnel.
* Compliance, Audit and Document Control: 8%
* Support ISO, RPSL and other Fleet Personnel audit preparations, including document collection, tracker maintenance and closure of agreed actions.
* Assist with updates to departmental manuals, procedures, records and controlled documents.
* Maintain organised and secure digital and physical filing systems for the Head of Fleet Personnel’s office.
* Ensure records are complete, current, readily retrievable and handled in accordance with company confidentiality and data\-protection requirements.
* Seafarer Welfare, Insurance and Recognition Programmes: 7%
* Coordinate administrative aspects of seafarer medical and life\-insurance programmes, including data updates, supporting documentation and follow\-up with service providers.
* Support humanitarian\-aid and other urgent seafarer welfare arrangements as directed.
* Administer long\-service and loyalty\-recognition programmes, including eligibility records, approved awards, procurement coordination and event logistics.
* Maintain accurate records of recognition items and ensure expenditure remains within approved budgets and processes.
* Forums, Town Halls and Stakeholder Events: 5%
* Support the planning and execution of seafarer forums, vessel town halls, leadership visits, conferences, seminars, roadshows and sponsorship activities.
* Coordinate participant lists, invitations, venues, suppliers, presentation materials, awards and event budgets.
* Liaise with regional offices, vessels, manning partners and internal functions to ensure timely and efficient delivery.
* Maintain event plans, cost trackers, records and post\-event actions.
* Calendar and Travel Coordination: 5%
* Manage the Head of Fleet Personnel’s calendar, including scheduling, prioritising and resolving conflicts across internal and external meetings.
* Anticipate scheduling requirements and ensure adequate preparation time for leadership meetings, operational reviews and external engagements.
* Coordinate domestic and international travel, including flights, accommodation, visas, invitation and coverage letters, ground transport and supporting documentation.
* Prepare and reconcile travel and business expenses through the applicable company expense\-management system.
* Provide timely support when travel arrangements or meeting schedules change outside standard office hours.
* General Departmental and Administrative Support: 5%
* Support vendor onboarding, invoice documentation, purchase coordination and routine departmental administration in accordance with approved processes.
* Coordinate office, equipment and logistical requirements for the Head of Fleet Personnel.
* Respond to routine stakeholder enquiries or direct them to the appropriate responsible person.
* Perform other reasonable duties assigned by the Head of Fleet Personnel in support of departmental priorities.


**Technical Skills**
**Key Skills and Capabilities**
* Advanced proficiency in Microsoft Outlook, Excel, Word, PowerPoint and Teams.
* Strong email organisation, correspondence tracking and action\-management capability.
* Ability to prepare professional correspondence, presentations, reports, dashboards, project plans and structured trackers.
* Strong digital and physical document\-management skills.
* Experience with enterprise systems such as COMPAS or other crew\-management systems, NetSuite, Certify, Concur, SharePoint or similar platforms would be an advantage.
* Ability to work accurately with operational, financial and personnel data.


**Professional Skills**
* Excellent written and verbal communication skills in English.
* High level of discretion, confidentiality, integrity and professional judgement.
* Strong project coordination, planning, organisation and stakeholder\-management skills.
* Ability to work independently, anticipate requirements and manage a high volume of competing priorities.
* Strong attention to detail, responsiveness and consistent follow\-through.
* Ability to engage confidently and respectfully with senior executives, seafarers, vessel teams, unions, manning partners, vendors and colleagues across cultures and time zones.
* Calm, dependable and solution\-oriented approach, particularly when handling urgent or sensitive matters.
* Resilience and the ability to maintain accuracy and professionalism in a fast\-paced, high\-intensity environment.


**Professional Experience And Education**
**Education**
* Bachelor’s degree in Business Administration, Commerce, Human Resources, Maritime Studies or a related discipline.


**Experience**
* At least five years of relevant experience in Fleet Personnel coordination, project coordination, executive support or senior administration, preferably supporting senior leadership.
* Demonstrated experience managing high\-volume email correspondence, multiple projects and concurrent deadlines in a demanding work environment.
* Experience in the maritime, ship\-management, crewing or logistics sector is preferred.
* Prior exposure to seafarer administration, CBA or union coordination, audit support, management reporting, travel, insurance, employee events or welfare programmes would be an advantage.


**Additional Requirements**
* Willingness to commit to a high\-intensity and high\-volume work environment, supported by prior experience in a role requiring sustained responsiveness and effective prioritisation.
* Availability on a 24/7 basis, when operationally necessary, to support meetings or urgent matters outside standard office hours due to Seaspan’s global operations.
* Flexibility to coordinate with stakeholders across international time zones and respond promptly to changing operational priorities.
* Ability to travel occasionally when required for Fleet Personnel forums, events or leadership support.
* Demonstrated commitment to Seaspan’s values, safety culture, confidentiality requirements and standards of professional conduct.


 Seaspan Corporation is an equal opportunity employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to age, race, colour, religion, gender, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, disability, or protected Veteran status. We thank all applicants in advance. If your application is shortlisted to be included in the interview process, one of our team will be in contact with you.

*

*

**Data, Reporting \& Insights** 
  

* 
+ Prepare periodic and on‑demand reports on training effectiveness, feedback, training hours, nominations, and completion metrics.
+ Analyse L\&D budget utilisation vs spend and highlight variances.
+ Provide insights to continuously improve the learning experience.


**Continuous Improvement** 
  

* 
+ Contribute to the development and updating of L\&D processes, policies, frameworks, and resources.

  1\. JOB PURPOSE
 



  





 The HR Intern will support the HR Department in day\-to\-day HR operations, recruitment, employee coordination, documentation, attendance management, onboarding, employee engagement, and HR process development.
 



  





 The intern will gain practical exposure to various HR functions while assisting the HR team in maintaining an organized, professional, and employee\-friendly workplace.
 



  





  





  





  2\. KEY RESPONSIBILITIES
 



  





  A. Recruitment \& Talent Acquisition

 \* Screen CVs and shortlist candidates based on job requirements.
 



 \* Coordinate with candidates regarding interview schedules.
 



 \* Conduct initial communication with candidates.
 



 \* Maintain candidate databases and recruitment trackers.
 



 \* Follow up with candidates regarding interview attendance and joining status.
 



 \* Coordinate interview schedules with the concerned department heads.
 



 \* Maintain records of shortlisted, rejected, selected, and joined candidates.
 



 \* Assist in preparing offer letters, appointment letters, internship letters, and other HR documents.
 



  





 B. Employee Onboarding
 



  





 \* Coordinate the joining process for new employees.
 



 \* Collect and verify required employee documents.
 



 \* Maintain employee personal and employment records.
 



 \* Assist in preparing joining forms and onboarding checklists.
 



 \* Coordinate introduction of new employees to the team.
 



 \* Assist in induction and orientation programs.
 



 \* Ensure new employees are added to relevant communication groups and HR systems.
 



 \* Maintain proper onboarding documentation.
 



  





  C. Attendance \& Leave Management
 



  





 \* Maintain daily employee attendance records.
 



 \* Monitor late coming, absenteeism, leave, and early departures.
 



 \* Assist in maintaining leave records.
 



 \* Follow up with employees regarding attendance irregularities.
 



 \* Prepare attendance reports for HR review.
 



 \* Assist in monthly attendance reconciliation.
 



 \* Coordinate with employees and reporting managers regarding attendance\-related queries.
 



  





  D. Employee Records \& HR Documentation
 



  





 \* Maintain updated employee master data.
 



 \* Organize employee files and documentation.
 



 \* Maintain records of Aadhaar, PAN, educational documents, experience letters, bank details, photographs, and other required documents.
 



 \* Assist in maintaining employee joining and exit records.
 



 \* Ensure HR documents are properly filed and updated.
 



 \* Maintain confidentiality of employee information.
 



  





  E. HR Operations
 



  





 \* Assist with daily HR administrative activities.
 



 \* Prepare HR reports, trackers, and MIS.
 



 \* Maintain recruitment and employee databases.
 



 \* Assist in preparing HR communications and notices.
 



 \* Coordinate with employees and department heads for HR\-related requirements.
 



 \* Support implementation of HR policies and procedures.
 



 \* Assist in maintaining HR calendars and employee\-related schedules.
 



  





  F. Employee Engagement
 



  





 \* Assist in organizing employee engagement activities.
 



 \* Coordinate birthday celebrations, employee events, festivals, and team activities.
 



 \* Support Employee of the Month initiatives.
 



 \* Collect employee feedback where required.
 



 \* Assist in maintaining employee engagement records.
 



 \* Support initiatives to improve employee communication and workplace culture.
 



  





  G. Performance Management \& HRIS
 



  





 \* Assist in maintaining employee performance records.
 



 \* Support the HR team in collecting performance feedback from reporting managers.
 



 \* Assist in maintaining KPI and performance assessment records.
 



 \* Support the implementation of the company's HRIS / Performance Management System.
 



 \* Assist in updating employee information and HR data in the company application.
 



 \* Help maintain performance review trackers and reports.
 



 \* Support Employee of the Month evaluation processes.
 



  





  H. Learning \& Development
 



  





 \* Assist in identifying employee training requirements.
 



 \* Coordinate training sessions and workshops.
 



 \* Maintain training attendance and participation records.
 



 \* Collect employee feedback after training programs.
 



 \* Assist in preparing training calendars.
 



 \* Maintain Learning \& Development documentation.
 



  





  I. Employee Communication
 



  





 \* Draft and circulate HR\-related communications.
 



 \* Coordinate with employees through email and WhatsApp groups when required.
 



 \* Communicate interview schedules, joining instructions, HR notices, and internal announcements.
 



 \* Maintain professional communication with candidates and employees.
 



 \* Assist in resolving basic employee queries and escalate complex matters to the HR Manager.
 



  





  J. Exit \& Separation Support
 



  





 \* Assist in the employee resignation and exit process.
 



 \* Maintain resignation and exit documentation.
 



 \* Coordinate exit formalities and clearance requirements.
 



 \* Assist in collecting exit feedback.
 



 \* Update employee records after separation.
 



 \* Coordinate with relevant departments for exit\-related documentation.
 



  





  





  





  3\. DAILY HR ACTIVITIES
 



  





 The HR Intern may be responsible for:
 



  





 \* Checking attendance and leave records.
 



 \* Following up with candidates.
 



 \* Scheduling interviews.
 



 \* Updating recruitment trackers.
 



 \* Maintaining employee records.
 



 \* Coordinating with employees and reporting managers.
 



 \* Updating HRIS / HR application data.
 



 \* Preparing HR reports and documents.
 



 \* Supporting ongoing HR activities.
 



 \* Handling routine HR coordination and administrative work.
 



  





  





  





  4\. SKILLS REQUIRED

 \* Good email drafting skills.
 



 \* Basic understanding of recruitment processes.
 



 \* Ability to maintain trackers and databases.
 



 \* Basic understanding of HR functions.
 



 \* Willingness to learn HRIS and HR technology.
 



  





  Soft Skills
 



  





 \* Good verbal and written communication.
 



 \* Professional attitude.
 



 \* Good interpersonal skills.
 



 \* Ability to coordinate with multiple people.
 



 \* Attention to detail.
 



 \* Good organizational skills.
 



 \* Time management.
 



 \* Follow\-up skills.
 



 \* Positive and learning\-oriented attitude.
 



 \* Ability to maintain confidentiality.
 



  





  





  5\. EDUCATIONAL QUALIFICATION
 



  





 \* Bachelor's degree in Human Resources, Business Administration, Management, Commerce, or a related field.

  6\. EXPERIENCE

  7\. KEY PERFORMANCE INDICATORS (KPIs)

 15\. Learning ability and initiative.
 



  





  





  8\. CAREER DEVELOPMENT / LEARNING AREAS
 



  





 During the internship, the HR Intern will receive practical exposure to:

 \* Interview Coordination
 



 \* Employee Onboarding

  9\. PERSONAL ATTRIBUTES

 10\. WORKING HOURS

 The employee/intern may be required to support urgent HR activities or business requirements outside normal working hours when reasonably required.
 



  





  





  11\. REPORTING \& COORDINATION
 



  





 The HR Intern will report to the \*HR Executive / HR Manager\* and will coordinate with:

  12\. CONFIDENTIALITY
 



  





 The HR Intern will have access to confidential employee and company information. All employee records, salary information, personal documents, HR reports, and internal company information must be kept strictly confidential.
 



  





 Any unauthorized sharing, copying, or disclosure of confidential information may result in appropriate disciplinary action as per company policy.
 



  





  





  13\. SUCCESS PROFILE
