title: Human Resource Internship
description:
**Job Description: HR Intern
 



  





 Company Overview:
 



 Launched in 2021, Mavenwit is a Global Award\-Winning Advertising and Marketing company committed to revolutionizing the industry through innovative strategies and cutting\-edge solutions. We work with over 100\+ global brand partners and serve diverse industries by offering essential advertising and marketing services under one roof. Our mission is to 10X the growth of every business through the power of the internet. We provide services in strategy, paid media, e\-commerce, creative, commercial ads, copywriting, production, branding, and much more. Mavenwit is driven by a commitment to excellence and results.
 



  





 Internship Role: HR Intern
 



  





 Department: Talent Acquisition
 



  





 Location: Remote (Work from Anywhere)
 



 Internship Type: Remote (Flexible Timings)
 



 Stipend: Unpaid
 



 Duration: Flexible, Based on Intern's Availability
 



 Overview:
 



 As an HR Intern at Mavenwit, you will play an essential role in the Talent Acquisition process, assisting with recruitment and onboarding. You'll get hands\-on experience managing candidate databases, coordinating interviews, and supporting our HR team in talent sourcing and engagement efforts. This is an opportunity to learn HR best practices while contributing to the growth of the company.
 



 Responsibilities:
 



 Maintain and update the Applicant Tracking System (ATS) database, ensuring candidate information is accurate and up to date.
 



 Coordinate interview schedules, follow\-ups, and feedback processes between hiring managers and candidates.
 



 Engage with potential candidates through email, phone calls, and other communication channels to initiate the recruitment process.
 



 Assist in sourcing candidates through job boards, social media, and other platforms.
 



 Participate in creating and organizing interview scheduling and candidate assessments.
 



 Assist with candidate onboarding and documentation once hired.
 



 Collaborate with HR and recruitment teams to support various talent acquisition projects.
 



  





 Skills/Requirements:
 



 Basic office skills are preferred (e.g., communication, organization).
 



 Strong organizational and time\-management skills.
 



 General knowledge of Boolean search techniques and job boards is a plus.
 



 Proficient in Microsoft Excel and basic data entry.
 



 Ability to work independently and in a team environment.
 



 A proactive attitude and willingness to learn new HR tools and systems.
 



  





 Post\-Hiring Work Opportunities:
 



 After successfully completing the internship, you may be considered for potential future opportunities at Mavenwit, such as:
 



 A full\-time position in our Talent Acquisition or HR team based on performance.
 



 Opportunities to lead HR\-related projects and initiatives.
 



 A chance to work with some of the most talented professionals in the advertising industry.
 



  





 Non\-Stipend Work Perks:
 



 While the internship does not offer a stipend, there are several exciting non\-monetary benefits and perks that come with working at Mavenwit:
 



 Fully Remote Work: Work from anywhere, providing flexibility for your personal and academic life.
 



 Certification \& Skill Development: Get certified from Mavenwit and our partner companies (including HubSpot, etc.) to enhance your skills and expertise.
 



 Project Certification: Receive a certification for the projects you work on during your internship.
 



 Performance\-Based Recognition: Win prizes through exciting contests and get a chance to stand out in the global advertising industry.
 



 Networking Opportunities: Connect with industry professionals and partners through Mavenwit’s broad network.
 



 Letter of Recommendation: Earn a recommendation letter based on your performance and contribution during the internship.
 



 Growth \& Learning: Gain valuable experience working with a fast\-growing team, and expand your knowledge in HR and talent acquisition.
 



  





 Additional Information:
 



 Timings: Flexible with two working shifts to accommodate different time zones and schedules.
 



 Work Culture: Mavenwit fosters an inclusive and diverse work environment where your ideas and work will be recognized and appreciated.
 



  





 Mavenwit Equal Employment Opportunity Statement:
 



 Mavenwit is committed to fostering diversity and inclusivity in our workforce. We are an Equal Employment Opportunity and Affirmative Action Employer. Qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, age, marital status, protected veteran status, or disability status. Mavenwit does not accept unsolicited resumes from headhunters or agencies.
 



 If you're passionate about talent acquisition, learning new HR practices, and making an impact in a rapidly growing company, we invite you to apply!
 



  





 Apply Now!
 



 Become part of Mavenwit and build your career in HR and Talent Acquisition!**

title: Senior Human Resources Manager
description:
**SENIOR MANAGER – HR**

 Employment Type: Full\-Time
   

 Department: Human Resource
   

  

 About the Role
   

  

 We are looking for an experienced and hands\-on Senior Manager – HR to lead and manage end\-to\-end Human Resources operations across the organization. The role will be responsible for ensuring effective HR processes, employee engagement, compliance, manpower planning, HR administration and smooth coordination between employees, management and business teams.
   

  

 The ideal candidate should have strong knowledge of HR Operations and Generalist functions, preferably within the hospitality/F\&B industry, with the ability to independently manage HR processes and resolve employee\-related matters.
   

  

 Key Responsibilities
   

  

 1\. End\-to\-End HR Operations
   

  

 \* Manage the complete employee lifecycle from recruitment and onboarding to separation and full \& final settlement.
   

 \* Maintain employee records, documentation, HR files and statutory records.
   

 \* Ensure timely issuance of appointment letters, confirmation letters, increment letters, transfer letters, warning letters and other HR documents.
   

 \* Handle employee grievances, disciplinary matters and workplace concerns.
   

 \* Drive smooth HR operations across multiple locations/outlets.

 \* Coordinate with Accounts/Finance for payroll\-related requirements.

 \* Coordinate with consultants and internal stakeholders for statutory compliance and documentation.
   

 \* Maintain compliance records and support inspections/audits when required.

 \* Develop, implement and update HR policies, SOPs, employee handbooks and HR processes.
   

 \* Establish standardized HR systems across locations.
   

 \* Ensure effective implementation of company policies and disciplinary procedures.
   

 \* Continuously identify opportunities to improve HR processes and employee experience.
   

  

 6\. Employee Relations \& Engagement
   

  

 \* Handle employee queries, grievances and disciplinary issues professionally.
   

 \* Conduct employee engagement initiatives, HR meetings, awareness sessions and internal communication.
   

 \* Promote a positive and professional workplace culture.
   

 \* Support managers in handling employee\-related matters.
   

  

 7\. Performance Management
   

  

 \* Coordinate probation, confirmation, appraisal and increment processes.
   

 \* Support managers in performance discussions and documentation.
   

 \* Monitor employee performance\-related concerns and initiate appropriate HR interventions.
   

  

 8\. HRMS \& MIS
   

  

 \* Manage HRMS processes including employee master data, attendance, leave and HR documentation.
   

 \* Prepare and maintain HR MIS reports related to manpower, recruitment, attrition, attendance and other HR metrics.
   

 \* Ensure accuracy and confidentiality of employee information.
   

  

 9\. POSH \& Workplace Compliance
   

  

 \* Support implementation of POSH and workplace conduct policies.
   

 \* Conduct/coordinate employee awareness and sensitization initiatives.
   

 \* Maintain appropriate documentation and ensure concerns are handled through the prescribed process.
   

  

 10\. HR Administration \& Coordination
   

  

 \* Coordinate with administration, finance, operations and management for HR\-related requirements.
   

 \* Support employee insurance/benefits and other employee welfare activities.
   

 \* Coordinate with vendors, consultants and external agencies as required.
   

 \* Provide HR support for new outlets, hotels, projects and business expansions.
   

  

 Required Skills \& Qualifications
   

  

 \* Graduate/Postgraduate degree in HR, Human Resources Management, Business Administration or related field.
   

 \* Minimum 5 years of relevant HR experience, preferably in Hospitality, F\&B, Hotels, Retail or other multi\-location environments.
   

 \* Strong knowledge of Hospitality Recruitment, HR Operations and Generalist HR functions.
   

 \* Good understanding of Indian labour laws and statutory compliance.
   

 \* Experience in payroll, attendance and HRMS management.
   

 \* Strong recruitment and employee relations experience.
   

 \* Excellent communication, interpersonal and problem\-solving skills.
   

 \* Ability to independently manage HR operations and work closely with senior management.
   

 \* Strong documentation, coordination and organizational skills.
   

 \* Good working knowledge of MS Excel and HRMS platforms.
   

  

 Key Competencies
   

  

 \* HR Operations \& Generalist HR
   

 \* Employee Relations
   

 \* Recruitment \& Manpower Planning
   

 \* Payroll \& Attendance
   

 \* Labour Law \& Statutory Compliance
   

 \* HR Policies \& SOPs
   

 \* Performance Management
   

 \* HRMS \& MIS
   

 \* Conflict Resolution
   

 \* Employee Engagement
   

 \* Stakeholder Management
   

 \* Team Management

 A hands\-on HR professional who can independently manage day\-to\-day HR operations and recruitments, build structured HR processes, work closely with business leaders and employees, and ensure that HR practices are aligned with business requirements and organizational policies.

title: Regional Employee Relations Lead - APAC
description:
We exist to create positive change for people and the planet. Join us and make a difference too!
   

  

**Role:**

 Either \- Greater China (Shanghai / Beijing / Guangzhou / Shenzhen), India (New Delhi / Mumbai), Malaysia (Kuala Lumpur), or Singapore
   

  

**Type:** 
 Hybrid, permanent, full\-time
   

  

**Reports to:** 
 Global Head of Employee Relations
   

  

**About The Role**
 We are looking for a
 **Regional Employee Relations Lead – Asia Pacific** 
 to lead BSI’s Employee Relations activity across a diverse and complex regional portfolio.
   

  

 Supporting BSI businesses across markets including China, India, Japan, Malaysia, Vietnam, Indonesia, Korea and Australia, you will provide regional leadership on complex employee relations matters while helping embed a consistent, high\-quality approach to case management, governance and employee experience.
   

  

 This is both a strategic and operational leadership role. You will oversee complex and high\-risk ER activity, advise on organisational change and restructuring, strengthen regional capability and ensure evolving employment legislation is translated into practical guidance for leaders and People teams.
   

  

 You will also lead in\-country ER Specialists across
 **China, India and Japan** 
 , while working closely with HR Generalists and Regional HR Managers across the wider APAC region.
   

  

**Key Responsibilities**
* Lead and oversee employee relations activity across the Asia Pacific region, ensuring complex and high\-risk cases are managed effectively and consistently.
* Provide specialist advice on complex ER matters, including investigations, performance, conduct, grievances, dismissals and other sensitive employee issues.
* Advise senior stakeholders on organisation design and business change, including restructures, mergers, acquisitions and divestments.
* Balance commercial requirements with employment law, regulatory obligations and BSI’s responsibilities towards its employees.
* Lead and develop in\-country ER Specialists across China, India and Japan and provide regional guidance to wider People teams.
* Ensure employment law developments and external insights are translated into practical guidance and communicated effectively across the region.
* Develop and embed consistent regional ER processes, governance, policies, documentation and case management standards.
* Lead the implementation of BSI’s Early Resolution Framework and other initiatives designed to reduce formal ER cases.
* Support employee relations activity involving Works Councils, labour unions, Collective Bargaining Agreements and employee forums where applicable.
* Analyse regional case data to identify trends, root causes and opportunities for sustainable improvement.
* Maintain regional ER dashboards and provide clear insight into case volumes, risks, themes and outcomes.
* Develop and deliver ER education and capability\-building programmes for managers, People teams and investigation managers.
* Partner with Centres of Excellence and the wider Employee Relations team to ensure global People initiatives are effectively implemented across APAC.
* Identify opportunities to improve ER processes through digitalisation, data and effective use of AI.
* Provide clear assessment of legal, employee and commercial risk and recommend pragmatic solutions to senior stakeholders.


**Essential**
**What we’re looking for...**
* Significant experience operating as an Employee Relations specialist or leader within a complex international organisation.
* Deep understanding of employment law and employee relations practices across Asia Pacific.
* Demonstrable experience managing complex and high\-risk employee relations matters, including within jurisdictions such as Japan and Korea.
* Experience advising on organisational change, restructuring and other complex workforce matters.
* Strong understanding of employee representation models across APAC, including unions, employee forums and collective arrangements.
* Experience creating or strengthening ER policies, frameworks, processes and ways of working.
* Strong commercial judgement with the ability to balance legal risk, employee experience and business requirements.
* Proven ability to influence senior leaders and provide clear, authoritative advice on complex matters.
* Experience leading and developing employees or specialist teams across multiple locations.
* Strong analytical capability with the ability to identify trends, root causes and sustainable solutions from ER data.
* Excellent communication skills with the ability to navigate different cultures, stakeholder groups and working environments.
* Resilient and comfortable operating in ambiguity and within a constantly evolving employment landscape.
* Business\-level written and spoken English.


**Highly Desirable**
* Experience working within a complex, global matrix organisation.
* Broader HR Operations or People function experience within an international business.
* Professional HR qualification or relevant degree.
* Conversational or professional capability in another language used within the APAC region.
* Experience designing and implementing ER frameworks or operating models across multiple jurisdictions.


**Do you believe the world deserves excellence?**
 We are proud to be the business improvement company for other organisations to become more sustainable and resilient and finally to inspire trust in their products, systems, services, and the world we live in.
   

  

 Headquartered in London, BSI is the world's first national standards organization with more than 100 years of experience. We are a global partner for 86,000 companies and organizations in over 193 countries, offering development, auditing, certification, and training services, including innovative software solutions and cyber security expertise for all industries: from aerospace and automotive to food, construction, energy, healthcare, IT and trade sectors. Incorporated by Royal Charter, we’re truly impartial, and home to the ultimate mark of trust, the Kitemark.
   

  

 Through our unique combination of consulting, training, assurance and regulatory services we bring solid and broad knowledge to every company.
   

  

 If you want to contribute to this inspiring challenge, bring your open and enthusiastic mindset to our dynamic team, apply now and become part of the BSI family!
   

  

***D\&I Policy***
*BSI is committed to ensuring the diversity of our workforce reflects that of our clients and the communities in which we operate. Our goal is to create a sense of belonging for all employees by providing opportunities to develop, grow, and engage with our global organization all while having fun doing great work. BSI is a community where everyone can thrive.*
 If you require any reasonable accommodations to be made on account of a disability or impairment throughout out our recruiting process, please inform your Talent Acquisition Partner.
   

  

**About Us**
 BSI is a business improvement and standards company and for over a century BSI has been recognized for having a positive impact on organizations and society, building trust and enhancing lives.
   

  

 Today BSI partners with more than 77,500 clients in 195 countries and engages with a 15,000 strong global community of experts, industry and consumer groups, organizations and governments.
   

  

 Utilizing its extensive expertise in key industry sectors \- including automotive, aerospace, built environment, food and retail, and healthcare \- BSI delivers on its purpose by helping its clients fulfil theirs.
   

  

 Living by our core values of Client\-Centricity, Agility, and Collaboration, BSI provides organizations with the confidence to grow by partnering with them to tackle society’s critical issues – from climate change to building trust in digital transformation and everything in between \- to accelerate progress towards a better society and a sustainable world.

Job Title: Manager \- HR Operations
   

  

 Experience: 6\+ years

**About Upstox**
 At Upstox, we're building the future of investing—simple, powerful, and for everyone. We're one of India's fastest\-growing fintech platforms, backed by the best in the business, including Mr. Ratan Tata and Tiger Global, and on a mission to make wealth creation accessible to every Indian. From first\-time investors to seasoned traders, millions trust us to power their financial journeys.
   

  

**About The Role**
 We are looking for an experienced HR Operations Manager to lead and manage day\-to\-day HR operations, employee lifecycle processes, HR policies, compliance, HR systems, and employee support. The role will work closely with employees, managers, Finance, Legal, Payroll, and business leadership to ensure efficient, compliant, and employee\-friendly HR operations.
   

  

 What you'll own:
   

  

* HR Operations \& Employee Lifecycle
* Own end\-to\-end employee lifecycle processes from onboarding to exit.
* Manage employee documentation, HR records, transfers, promotions, confirmations, and exits.
* Ensure accurate and timely maintenance of employee data and HR documentation.
* Establish and improve HR processes, SOPs, and service standards.
* Manage employee queries and ensure timely resolution through HR helpdesk/ticketing mechanisms.
* HR Policies \& Processes
* Develop, implement, and periodically review HR policies and processes.
* Ensure consistent application of HR policies across teams and locations.
* Identify process gaps and drive automation and continuous improvement.
* Create HR dashboards, MIS, and periodic reports for management.
* Payroll \& Benefits
* Coordinate with payroll/Finance teams for accurate and timely payroll processing.
* Validate payroll inputs including attendance, leave, incentives, deductions, reimbursements, and employee changes.
* Manage employee benefits such as insurance, leave, gratuity, and other company\-sponsored programs.
* Resolve payroll and benefits\-related employee queries.
* Statutory Compliance
* Ensure compliance with applicable employment and labour laws.
* Coordinate statutory requirements including PF, ESI, Professional Tax, TDS, gratuity, Shops \& Establishments, and other applicable regulations.
* Maintain required HR records and documentation.
* Coordinate internal and external audits related to HR operations and compliance.
* HRMS \& Data Management
* Own HRMS administration and ensure accurate employee master data.
* Drive automation of HR processes wherever possible.
* Monitor data accuracy, access controls, and HR reporting.
* Work with HR technology vendors for system enhancements and issue resolution.
* Employee Experience
* Act as a point of contact for employee HR\-related queries and concerns.
* Improve employee experience across onboarding, lifecycle events, and exits.
* Develop employee communication processes and HR service standards.
* Partner with HR Business Partners and business leaders on employee\-related operational matters.
* HR Governance \& Reporting
* Prepare monthly/quarterly HR MIS and dashboards.
* Track key HR metrics such as headcount, attrition, absenteeism, hiring, onboarding, exits, payroll accuracy, and employee queries.
* Identify trends and provide actionable insights to HR leadership. Maintain HR SOPs, process documentation, and audit records.


 Who you are:
   

  

* 6–10 years of experience in HR Operations, HR Shared Services, HR Generalist, or a similar role.
* Strong understanding of employee lifecycle management and HR processes.
* Good knowledge of Indian labour and statutory compliance.
* Experience managing HRMS and HR process automation.
* Strong exposure to payroll, benefits, HR MIS, and employee documentation.
* Experience working with Finance, Legal, business leaders, and external vendors.
* Strong analytical, problem\-solving, communication, and stakeholder\-management skills.
* Ability to independently manage HR operations in a fast\-growing organization.


 By applying for this position, you acknowledge that you have reviewed our Prospective Employee Privacy Notice, which outlines how Upstox collects, uses, and protects your Personal Information ('PI'). I accept Upstox's Prospective Employee Privacy Notice.
   

  

 Upstox is an Equal Opportunity Employer; all qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, colour, religion, gender, gender identity or expression, sexual orientation, national origin, genetics, disability, age, veteran status, or other characteristics.

title: Deputy General Manager - Organisation Culture & Engagement
description:
**Job Requirements**
 About Godrej Industries Group (GIG)
   

  

 At the Godrej Industries Group, we are privileged to serve over 1\.1 billion consumers globally through our businesses with market leadership positions in the consumer products, real estate, agriculture, financial services and chemicals industries
   

  

 www.godrejindustries.com
   

  

**About Godrej Properties Limited (GPL)**
 Godrej Properties brings the Godrej Group philosophy of innovation, sustainability, and excellence to the real estate industry. Each Godrej Properties development combines the over 125\-year legacy of excellence and trust with a commitment to cutting\-edge design, technology, and sustainability.
   

  

 www.godrejproperties.com
   

  

 Position Overview
   

  

 The DGM — Organisation Culture \& Engagement will be the custodian of Godrej Properties' people culture — defining what it means to work here, making that real across every level of the organisation, and building an engaged workforce that drives business outcomes. This is a senior individual contributor and influencing role, working closely with the Head\-COEs, CHRO and business leadership.
   

  

 Culture Architecture \& Activation
   

  

* Define, articulate and embed the Godrej Way culture framework — values, behaviours, and ways of working — across the employee lifecycle
* Partner with business leaders to ensure culture is lived and not just stated, with visible behavioural anchors at every level
* Design and run culture diagnostics to identify gaps between desired and current culture; build action plans against findings
* Lead culture integration work during periods of organisational change, growth, or restructuring


 Employee Engagement
   

  

* Own the GPL engagement measurement strategy — design, run, and analyse engagement surveys (including Gallup, Amber or equivalent) across the organisation
* Translate engagement data into actionable insights; work with HRBPs and business heads to drive meaningful interventions at function and team level
* Build and sustain a cadence of engagement touchpoints — pulse checks, focus groups, manager\-led rituals — that keep the organisation connected and energised
* Drive recognition frameworks that reinforce culture and sustain engagement beyond survey cycles


 Manager \& Leadership Enablement
   

  

* Build capability among people managers to drive engagement within their teams — playbooks, toolkits, coaching nudges
* Partner with L\&D to embed culture and engagement into leadership development programmes
* Work with senior leaders to role\-model and cascade cultural behaviours visibly


 Measurement \& Reporting
   

  

* Own the engagement and culture scorecard; report progress to CHRO and leadership team quarterly
* Define and track MOPs: engagement scores, manager effectiveness, culture index


 Who are we looking for?
   

  

* 2019\-2021 batch passout from premier b\-schools
* Demonstrated experience running large\-scale engagement programmes (Gallup Q12 preferred)
* Strong diagnostic ability — comfortable with data, surveys, and translating numbers into people insights
* Excellent stakeholder management and influencing skills — this role works across levels without direct authority
* Strong written and verbal communication — able to build narratives, write well, present confidently
* Experience in real estate, infrastructure, or similarly project\-driven, distributed organisations is a plus


 What Success Looks Like in Year One
   

  

* Engagement score improvement to 85th percentile for the BU
* Engagement survey completed, results socialised, and function\-level action plans live
* Culture framework documented and activated with visible behavioural markers
* Manager enablement toolkit deployed


**Work Experience**
 6–8 years
   

  

**Benefits**
 What’s in it for you?
   

  

 Be an equal parent
   

  

*Maternity support, including paid leave ahead of statutory guidelines, and flexible work options on return*
*Paternity support, including paid leave*
*New mothers can bring a caregiver and children under a year old, on work travel*
*Adoption support; gender neutral and based on the primary caregiver, with paid leave options*
 No place for discrimination at Godrej
   

  

*Gender\-neutral anti\-harassment policy*
*Same sex partner benefits at par with married spouses*
*Gender transition support*
 We are selfish about your wellness
   

  

*Comprehensive health insurance plans, as well as accident coverage for you and your family, with top\-up options*
*Trust based sick leave*
*Mental wellness and self\-care programmes, resources and counselling*
 Celebrating wins, the Godrej Way
   

  

*Structured recognition platforms for individual, team and business\-level achievements*
*Performance\-based earning opportunities*
 https://www.godrejcareers.com/benefits/
   

  

 An inclusive Godrej
   

  

 Before you go, there is something important we want to highlight. There is no place for discrimination at Godrej. Diversity is the philosophy of who we are as a company. And has been for over a century. It’s not just in our DNA and nice to do. Being more diverse \- especially having our team members reflect the diversity of our businesses and communities \- helps us innovate better and grow faster. We hope this resonates with you.
   

  

 We take pride in being an equal opportunities employer. We recognise merit and encourage diversity. We do not tolerate any form of discrimination on the basis of nationality, race, colour, religion, caste, gender identity or expression, sexual orientation, disability, age, or marital status and ensure equal opportunities for all our team members.
   

  

 If this sounds like a role for you, apply now! We look forward to meeting you.

* Ensures that Crew Management delivers on KPIs agreed upon between client, Fleet Cells, and Crew Management, including budget ownership for crew operations.
* Ensures the diligent usage of ShipSure as the system of record for all crewing activities and drives it with other teams for their crew and vessels.


**Crew Planning \& Workforce Management**
* Responsible for crew engagement and crew welfare.
* Maintains an effective crew rotation plan for assigned vessels, ensuring consistency with global planning principles and as guided by Global Pool Managers.

**Budget Management \& Operational Efficiency**
* Owns and manages the Vessel budget, including annual renewals, negotiation with customers and reporting.
* Owns and manage budget preparation by providing insights on wages, benefits, and crewing costs in collaboration with the P\&L team.
* Schedules and reports on service performance and budget reviews, recommending actions to support continuous improvement.


**Compliance, Industrial Relations \& HSSEQ Support**
* Ensures compliance with maritime regulations, flag state requirements, and industrial relations for assigned fleets.
* Manages urgent crew changes and vacancies through the effective utilization of the V.Ships seafarer pool.
* Assists HSSEQ in accident investigations related to crewing and supports the implementation of corrective/preventive actions.
* Drive data quality and comply with Quality Assurance process (Audit)


**Stakeholder Engagement \& Process Improvement**
* Participate in the new business proposal preparation and review as well as new business onboarding process.
* Collaborates proactively with internal and external stakeholders, including seafarers to ensure outstanding service delivery.
* Be familiar with and promote V.Group and Marine HR services and initiatives.
* Provides feedback on ShipSure enhancements and other crewing process improvements.
* Works digitally with V.Crew Connect, ShipSure BI, and other digital tools to streamline operations.
* Delivers client reports, ensuring transparency and data\-driven insights into seafarer management and operational performance.


**What can I expect in return?** 
 V. Group can offer you a market leading salary and benefits package, in addition to significant opportunities for career growth and personal development. This a great opportunity to join a true leader in the maritime sector \- a company that has exciting plans for future growth.
   

  

**Essential**
* Maritime or shipping industry experience
* Knowledge of crew operations, planning, and workforce management.

* Excellent organizational, and problem\-solving skills.
* Strong collaboration and influencing skills to drive change and improvement.
* Ability to manage budgets, reports, and performance KPIs effectively.
* Excellent communication skills, with an ability to negotiate and resolve conflicts effectively.
* Good technology and data analysis proficiency.


**Desirable**

title: Deputy General Manager - Diversity, Equity & Inclusion
description:
**Job Requirements**
 About Godrej Industries Group (GIG)
   

  

 At the Godrej Industries Group, we are privileged to serve over 1\.1 billion consumers globally through our businesses with market leadership positions in the consumer products, real estate, agriculture, financial services and chemicals industries
   

  

 www.godrejindustries.com
   

  

**About Godrej Properties Limited (GPL)**
 Godrej Properties brings the Godrej Group philosophy of innovation, sustainability, and excellence to the real estate industry. Each Godrej Properties development combines the over 125\-year legacy of excellence and trust with a commitment to cutting\-edge design, technology, and sustainability.
   

  

 www.godrejproperties.com
   

  

 Position Overview
   

  

 The DGM — DEI will build and lead Godrej Properties' diversity, equity and inclusion agenda — moving it from intent to measurable impact. This role is responsible for designing the DEI strategy, embedding it across talent processes, driving representation goals, and building an inclusive culture where every employee can do their best work. The role reports to the Head COEs and works closely with business and HR leadership.
   

  

 Strategy \& Roadmap
   

  

* Design and own the GPL DEI strategy — short and long\-term roadmap with clear goals, interventions, and measurable outcomes
* Conduct a DEI diagnostic across the organisation — representation data, pay equity, inclusion sentiment, policy gaps — to establish baseline and priorities
* Benchmark GPL's DEI position against real estate sector peers and identify aspiration gaps


 Representation \& Hiring
   

  

* Partner with Talent Acquisition to embed DEI into sourcing, screening, and selection — diverse slates, structured interviews, bias mitigation
* Set and track representation targets across gender, differently\-abled, LGBTQ\+, and other dimensions across levels and functions
* Build pipelines for underrepresented groups — campus partnerships, return\-to\-work programmes, industry collaboration


 Inclusion \& Equity
   

  

* Audit and improve people processes — performance, promotions, pay, development — for equity and bias
* Design and run inclusion interventions — safe spaces, employee resource groups (ERGs), allyship programmes, inclusive leadership development
* Ensure policies (maternity, paternity, POSH, flexible work) are not just compliant but genuinely inclusive in spirit and practice


 Culture \& Capability
   

  

* Build DEI awareness and capability across the organisation — workshops, toolkits, leader conversations, manager nudges
* Partner with L\&D to embed inclusive leadership into all people manager and leadership programmes
* Drive visible DEI moments through the internal communications calendar — days of significance, storytelling, recognition


 Measurement \& Reporting
   

  

* Own the DEI scorecard — representation metrics, inclusion index, pay equity data — reported to leadership and Board as applicable
* Track progress rigorously and course\-correct with data


 Who are we looking for?
   

  

* Batch of 2019\-2021 from premier b\-schools
* Strong understanding of the Indian DEI landscape — gender, disability, LGBTQ\+, generational diversity — and what works in practice, not just in theory
* Experience designing and running DEI programmes at scale in complex organisations
* Data fluency — comfortable building representation dashboards, analysing pay equity, and presenting insights to leadership
* Excellent influencing and communication skills — able to build conviction without mandate
* Knowledge of POSH, statutory compliance, and relevant Indian regulatory context
* Real estate or infrastructure sector experience preferred; large, multi\-site, blue\-collar\-inclusive organisations a strong plus


 What Success Looks Like in Year One
   

  

* Representation targets set and tracking live across gender, lgbtq\+, PWD
* At least one ERG or structured inclusion programme launched and active
* DEI embedded into at least two core talent processes (hiring, performance, or promotions)
* Inclusion sentiment score established as a baseline for future measurement


**Work Experience**
 6–8 years
   

  

**Benefits**
 What’s in it for you?
   

  

 Be an equal parent
   

  

*Maternity support, including paid leave ahead of statutory guidelines, and flexible work options on return*
*Paternity support, including paid leave*
*New mothers can bring a caregiver and children under a year old, on work travel*
*Adoption support; gender neutral and based on the primary caregiver, with paid leave options*
 No place for discrimination at Godrej
   

  

*Gender\-neutral anti\-harassment policy*
*Same sex partner benefits at par with married spouses*
*Gender transition support*
 We are selfish about your wellness
   

  

*Comprehensive health insurance plans, as well as accident coverage for you and your family, with top\-up options*
*Trust based sick leave*
*Mental wellness and self\-care programmes, resources and counselling*
 Celebrating wins, the Godrej Way
   

  

*Structured recognition platforms for individual, team and business\-level achievements*
*Performance\-based earning opportunities*
 https://www.godrejcareers.com/benefits/
   

  

 An inclusive Godrej
   

  

 Before you go, there is something important we want to highlight. There is no place for discrimination at Godrej. Diversity is the philosophy of who we are as a company. And has been for over a century. It’s not just in our DNA and nice to do. Being more diverse \- especially having our team members reflect the diversity of our businesses and communities \- helps us innovate better and grow faster. We hope this resonates with you.
   

  

 We take pride in being an equal opportunities employer. We recognise merit and encourage diversity. We do not tolerate any form of discrimination on the basis of nationality, race, colour, religion, caste, gender identity or expression, sexual orientation, disability, age, or marital status and ensure equal opportunities for all our team members.
   

  

 If this sounds like a role for you, apply now! We look forward to meeting you.

title: Senior Executive Human Resources
description:
**About Expenzing** 


 Expenzing is India’s leading spend management software company, helping finance teams achieve compliance, spend control, faster cycle times, and higher productivity. Our suite covers Accounts Payable Automation, Travel \& Employee Expenses, Vendor Portals, Procure\-to\-Pay, Budgeting, RFPs, and Fixed Asset Management—ensuring a seamless employee experience with strong financial governance.
 




  




**Role Overview** 


 We are looking for a proactive and enthusiastic Senior Executive Human Resource with 3\+ years of experience to join us. The role offers hands\-on exposure to various facets of Human Resources including recruitment, payroll, onboarding, administration, and employee engagement.
 




  




**Key Responsibilities** 
* Manage end\-to\-end recruitment process including sourcing, screening, scheduling interviews, and onboarding candidates.
* Coordinate with department heads to understand hiring requirements and manpower planning.
* Handle employee onboarding, induction, documentation, and exit formalities.
* Process monthly payroll inputs including attendance, leaves, incentives, deductions, and reimbursements.
* Maintain employee records, HR databases, and confidential personnel files.
* Ensure compliance with labor laws, statutory regulations, and company HR policies.
* Coordinate statutory activities related to PF, ESIC, gratuity, bonus, and other compliance requirements.
* Address employee queries related to HR policies, payroll, attendance, and benefits.
* Plan and execute employee engagement activities, celebrations, wellness initiatives, and team\-building programs.
* Support performance management processes including appraisals, feedback, and employee development initiatives.
* Prepare HR reports, MIS, attendance records, and recruitment status updates.
* Assist in drafting HR letters, policies, contracts, and official communications.
* Coordinate daily administrative activities including office management, vendor coordination, and employee support.



  




**Desired Skills \& Qualities** 
* Strong communication and interpersonal skills.
* Good organizational and time management abilities.
* Proficiency in MS Office (Excel, Word, PowerPoint.
* Ability to maintain confidentiality and handle sensitive information.
* Eagerness to build a career in Human Resources.



  




**Qualification** 
* Bachelor’s degree in HR, Business Administration, or related field.
